# 2.0) Build ACS 5-year block group sex controls for PopulationSim
# Reader note: this cell implements the section described above and writes only the configured intermediate/final outputs.

file_date = RUN_DATE
acs_year = YEAR
acs_dataset = "acs/acs5"
base_url = f"https://api.census.gov/data/{acs_year}/{acs_dataset}"

sex_control_columns = {
    "MALE": "B01001_002E",
    "FEMALE": "B01001_026E",
}
sex_columns = list(sex_control_columns.keys())
api_fields = ["NAME", "B01001_001E", *sex_control_columns.values()]

block_group_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_SexControlsBG_{file_date}.csv"
validation_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_SexControlsBG_validation_{file_date}.csv"


def fetch_acs_block_group_sex_data(county_name, county_fips, max_attempts=3):
    params = {
        "get": ",".join(api_fields),
        "for": "block group:*",
        "in": f"state:{state_code} county:{str(county_fips).zfill(3)} tract:*",
        "key": API_KEY,
    }

    for attempt in range(1, max_attempts + 1):
        try:
            response = requests.get(base_url, params=params, timeout=(10, 180))
            if response.status_code == 204:
                raise ValueError(f"No ACS sex data returned for {county_name} County ({county_fips}).")
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            return pd.DataFrame(data[1:], columns=data[0])
        except (requests.exceptions.RequestException, ValueError) as error:
            if attempt == max_attempts:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"ACS sex control request failed for {county_name} County after {max_attempts} attempts."
                ) from error
            wait_seconds = 5 * attempt
            print(f"ACS request failed for {county_name} County on attempt {attempt}; retrying in {wait_seconds} seconds...")
            time.sleep(wait_seconds)

    raise RuntimeError(f"ACS sex control request failed for {county_name} County.")


county_frames = []
for county_name, county_fips in county_fips_dict.items():
    county_frame = fetch_acs_block_group_sex_data(county_name, county_fips)
    county_frame["county_name"] = county_name
    county_frames.append(county_frame)
    print(f"Fetched ACS B01001 block group sex controls for {county_name} County: {len(county_frame):,} rows")

acs_sex = pd.concat(county_frames, ignore_index=True)

numeric_columns = ["B01001_001E", *sex_control_columns.values()]
acs_sex[numeric_columns] = acs_sex[numeric_columns].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)
acs_sex["state"] = acs_sex["state"].astype(str).str.zfill(2)
acs_sex["county"] = acs_sex["county"].astype(str).str.zfill(3)
acs_sex["tract"] = acs_sex["tract"].astype(str).str.zfill(6)
acs_sex["block group"] = acs_sex["block group"].astype(str).str.zfill(1)
acs_sex["BlockGroup"] = acs_sex["state"] + acs_sex["county"] + acs_sex["tract"] + acs_sex["block group"]

for output_column, source_column in sex_control_columns.items():
    acs_sex[output_column] = acs_sex[source_column].astype(int)

acs_sex["POPBASE"] = acs_sex[sex_columns].sum(axis=1).astype(int)
acs_sex["B01001_TOTAL"] = acs_sex["B01001_001E"].astype(int)
acs_sex["SEX_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"] = acs_sex["POPBASE"] - acs_sex["B01001_TOTAL"]

block_group_controls = acs_sex[["BlockGroup", *sex_columns, "POPBASE"]].sort_values("BlockGroup")
validation = acs_sex[["BlockGroup", "NAME", "B01001_TOTAL", "POPBASE", "SEX_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"]].copy()

block_group_controls.to_csv(block_group_output_path, index=False)
validation.to_csv(validation_output_path, index=False)

mismatch_count = validation["SEX_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"].ne(0).sum()
print(f"Saved block group sex controls: {block_group_output_path}")
print(f"Saved validation file: {validation_output_path}")
print(f"Block groups: {len(block_group_controls):,}")
print(f"Block group POPBASE total: {block_group_controls['POPBASE'].sum():,}")
if mismatch_count:
    print(f"WARNING: {mismatch_count:,} block group(s) have sex totals that do not match B01001_001E. Review {validation_output_path}.")

block_group_controls.head()

# 2.1) Review sex-control distributions by county
# Reader note: this cell implements the section described above and writes only the configured intermediate/final outputs.

file_date = RUN_DATE
acs_year = YEAR
sex_controls_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_SexControlsBG_{file_date}.csv"
review_output_dir = OUTPUT_DIR / "SexControlsBG_review"
county_summary_path = review_output_dir / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_SexControlsBG_county_summary_{file_date}.csv"
county_chart_paths = []

review_output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

if not sex_controls_path.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Sex controls file not found: {sex_controls_path}")

sex_columns = ["MALE", "FEMALE"]
required_columns = {"BlockGroup", "POPBASE", *sex_columns}

sex_controls = pd.read_csv(sex_controls_path, dtype={"BlockGroup": "string"})
missing_columns = sorted(required_columns - set(sex_controls.columns))
if missing_columns:
    raise KeyError(f"Sex controls file is missing required column(s): {missing_columns}")

county_lookup = {str(fips).zfill(3): county_name for county_name, fips in county_fips_dict.items()}
sex_controls["BlockGroup"] = sex_controls["BlockGroup"].astype(str).str.zfill(12)
sex_controls["county_fips"] = sex_controls["BlockGroup"].str[2:5]
sex_controls["county_name"] = sex_controls["county_fips"].map(county_lookup).fillna("Unknown")
sex_controls[sex_columns + ["POPBASE"]] = sex_controls[sex_columns + ["POPBASE"]].apply(
    pd.to_numeric,
    errors="coerce",
).fillna(0)

county_summary = (
    sex_controls.groupby(["county_fips", "county_name"], as_index=False)[sex_columns + ["POPBASE"]]
    .sum()
    .sort_values("county_fips")
)
county_summary.to_csv(county_summary_path, index=False)

plt.style.use("seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid")

for _, county_row in county_summary.iterrows():
    county_name = county_row["county_name"]
    county_fips = county_row["county_fips"]
    values = county_row[sex_columns].astype(int)
    chart_path = review_output_dir / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_SexControlsBG_{county_fips}_{county_name.replace(' ', '')}_{file_date}.png"

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 5))
    bars = ax.bar(sex_columns, values, color=["#4C78A8", "#F58518"], width=0.55)
    ax.set_title(f"{county_name} County ACS {acs_year} 5-Year Sex Controls")
    ax.set_xlabel("Sex")
    ax.set_ylabel("Population")
    ax.bar_label(bars, labels=[f"{value:,.0f}" for value in values], padding=3, fontsize=10)
    ax.margins(y=0.18)
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(chart_path, dpi=200, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.show()
    county_chart_paths.append(chart_path)

print(f"Saved county sex summary: {county_summary_path}")
print("Saved county sex charts:")
for chart_path in county_chart_paths:
    print(f"  {chart_path}")

county_summary

# 3.0) Build ACS 5-year tract occupation controls for PopulationSim
# Reader note: this cell implements the section described above and writes only the configured intermediate/final outputs.

file_date = RUN_DATE
acs_year = YEAR
acs_dataset = "acs/acs5"
base_url = f"https://api.census.gov/data/{acs_year}/{acs_dataset}"

occupation_control_columns = {
    "OCC_T": "B08124_001E",
    "OCC_1_MGMT": "B08124_002E",
    "OCC_2_SVC": "B08124_003E",
    "OCC_3_SALES": "B08124_004E",
    "OCC_4_NAT": "B08124_005E",
    "OCC_5_PROD": "B08124_006E",
    "OCC_6_MIL": "B08124_007E",
}
occupation_columns = [column for column in occupation_control_columns if column != "OCC_T"]
b08124_variables = list(occupation_control_columns.values())
api_fields = ["NAME"] + b08124_variables

tract_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_OccupationControlsTract_{file_date}.csv"
validation_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_OccupationControlsTract_validation_{file_date}.csv"


def fetch_acs_tract_occupation_data(county_name, county_fips, max_attempts=3):
    params = {
        "get": ",".join(api_fields),
        "for": "tract:*",
        "in": f"state:{state_code} county:{str(county_fips).zfill(3)}",
        "key": API_KEY,
    }

    for attempt in range(1, max_attempts + 1):
        try:
            response = requests.get(base_url, params=params, timeout=(10, 180))
            if response.status_code == 204:
                raise ValueError(f"No ACS occupation data returned for {county_name} County ({county_fips}).")
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            return pd.DataFrame(data[1:], columns=data[0])
        except (requests.exceptions.RequestException, ValueError) as error:
            if attempt == max_attempts:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"ACS 5-year tract occupation control request failed for {county_name} County after {max_attempts} attempts."
                ) from error
            wait_seconds = 5 * attempt
            print(f"ACS request failed for {county_name} County on attempt {attempt}; retrying in {wait_seconds} seconds...")
            time.sleep(wait_seconds)

    raise RuntimeError(f"ACS 5-year tract occupation control request failed for {county_name} County.")


county_frames = []
for county_name, county_fips in county_fips_dict.items():
    county_frame = fetch_acs_tract_occupation_data(county_name, county_fips)
    county_frame["county_name"] = county_name
    county_frames.append(county_frame)
    print(f"Fetched ACS B08124 tract occupation controls for {county_name} County: {len(county_frame):,} rows")

acs_occupation = pd.concat(county_frames, ignore_index=True)

numeric_columns = b08124_variables
acs_occupation[numeric_columns] = acs_occupation[numeric_columns].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)
acs_occupation["state"] = acs_occupation["state"].astype(str).str.zfill(2)
acs_occupation["county"] = acs_occupation["county"].astype(str).str.zfill(3)
acs_occupation["tract"] = acs_occupation["tract"].astype(str).str.zfill(6)
acs_occupation["TRACT"] = acs_occupation["state"] + acs_occupation["county"] + acs_occupation["tract"]

for occupation_column, source_column in occupation_control_columns.items():
    acs_occupation[occupation_column] = acs_occupation[source_column].astype(int)

acs_occupation["OCC_SUM"] = acs_occupation[occupation_columns].sum(axis=1).astype(int)
acs_occupation["OCCUPATION_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"] = acs_occupation["OCC_SUM"] - acs_occupation["OCC_T"]

tract_controls = acs_occupation[["TRACT", "OCC_T", *occupation_columns]].sort_values("TRACT")
validation = acs_occupation[["TRACT", "NAME", "OCC_T", "OCC_SUM", "OCCUPATION_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"]].copy()

tract_controls.to_csv(tract_output_path, index=False)
validation.to_csv(validation_output_path, index=False)

mismatch_count = validation["OCCUPATION_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"].ne(0).sum()
print(f"Saved tract occupation controls: {tract_output_path}")
print(f"Saved validation file: {validation_output_path}")
print(f"Tracts: {len(tract_controls):,}")
print(f"Tract OCC_T total: {tract_controls['OCC_T'].sum():,}")
if mismatch_count:
    print(f"WARNING: {mismatch_count:,} tract(s) have occupation categories that do not sum to OCC_T. Review {validation_output_path}.")

# 4.0) Build ACS 5-year tract household-worker controls for PopulationSim
# Reader note: this cell implements the section described above and writes only the configured intermediate/final outputs.

file_date = RUN_DATE
acs_year = YEAR
acs_dataset = "acs/acs5"
base_url = f"https://api.census.gov/data/{acs_year}/{acs_dataset}"

worker_control_columns = {
    "HHWORKER0": "B08202_002E",
    "HHWORKER1": "B08202_003E",
    "HHWORKER2": "B08202_004E",
    "HHWORKER3P": "B08202_005E",
}
worker_columns = list(worker_control_columns.keys())
b08202_variables = ["B08202_001E", *worker_control_columns.values()]
api_fields = ["NAME"] + b08202_variables

tract_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_HouseholdWorkerControlsTract_{file_date}.csv"
validation_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_HouseholdWorkerControlsTract_validation_{file_date}.csv"


def fetch_acs_tract_household_worker_data(county_name, county_fips, max_attempts=3):
    params = {
        "get": ",".join(api_fields),
        "for": "tract:*",
        "in": f"state:{state_code} county:{str(county_fips).zfill(3)}",
        "key": API_KEY,
    }

    for attempt in range(1, max_attempts + 1):
        try:
            response = requests.get(base_url, params=params, timeout=(10, 180))
            if response.status_code == 204:
                raise ValueError(f"No ACS household-worker data returned for {county_name} County ({county_fips}).")
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            return pd.DataFrame(data[1:], columns=data[0])
        except (requests.exceptions.RequestException, ValueError) as error:
            if attempt == max_attempts:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"ACS 5-year tract household-worker control request failed for {county_name} County after {max_attempts} attempts."
                ) from error
            wait_seconds = 5 * attempt
            print(f"ACS request failed for {county_name} County on attempt {attempt}; retrying in {wait_seconds} seconds...")
            time.sleep(wait_seconds)

    raise RuntimeError(f"ACS 5-year tract household-worker control request failed for {county_name} County.")


county_frames = []
for county_name, county_fips in county_fips_dict.items():
    county_frame = fetch_acs_tract_household_worker_data(county_name, county_fips)
    county_frame["county_name"] = county_name
    county_frames.append(county_frame)
    print(f"Fetched ACS B08202 tract household-worker controls for {county_name} County: {len(county_frame):,} rows")

acs_workers = pd.concat(county_frames, ignore_index=True)

numeric_columns = b08202_variables
acs_workers[numeric_columns] = acs_workers[numeric_columns].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)
acs_workers["state"] = acs_workers["state"].astype(str).str.zfill(2)
acs_workers["county"] = acs_workers["county"].astype(str).str.zfill(3)
acs_workers["tract"] = acs_workers["tract"].astype(str).str.zfill(6)
acs_workers["TRACT"] = acs_workers["state"] + acs_workers["county"] + acs_workers["tract"]

for worker_column, source_column in worker_control_columns.items():
    acs_workers[worker_column] = acs_workers[source_column].astype(int)

acs_workers["HHBASE"] = acs_workers[worker_columns].sum(axis=1).astype(int)
acs_workers["B08202_TOTAL"] = acs_workers["B08202_001E"].astype(int)
acs_workers["HOUSEHOLD_WORKER_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"] = acs_workers["HHBASE"] - acs_workers["B08202_TOTAL"]

tract_controls = acs_workers[["TRACT", *worker_columns, "HHBASE"]].sort_values("TRACT")
validation = acs_workers[["TRACT", "NAME", "B08202_TOTAL", "HHBASE", "HOUSEHOLD_WORKER_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"]].copy()

tract_controls.to_csv(tract_output_path, index=False)
validation.to_csv(validation_output_path, index=False)

mismatch_count = validation["HOUSEHOLD_WORKER_TOTAL_DIFFERENCE"].ne(0).sum()
print(f"Saved tract household-worker controls: {tract_output_path}")
print(f"Saved validation file: {validation_output_path}")
print(f"Tracts: {len(tract_controls):,}")
print(f"Tract HHBASE total: {tract_controls['HHBASE'].sum():,}")
if mismatch_count:
    print(f"WARNING: {mismatch_count:,} tract(s) have household-worker categories that do not sum to B08202_001E. Review {validation_output_path}.")

# Clean household-size distributions before writing the BG control file.
def fill_missing_hhsize_controls(df, size_cols, geoid_col="BlockGroup"):
    df_clean = df.copy()
    df_clean[size_cols] = df_clean[size_cols].fillna(0).clip(lower=0)
    df_clean["GEOID_str"] = df_clean[geoid_col].astype(str).str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(12)
    df_clean["Tract"] = df_clean["GEOID_str"].str[:11]
    df_clean["County"] = df_clean["GEOID_str"].str[:5]
    df_clean["Total_HH"] = df_clean[size_cols].sum(axis=1)

    empty_mask = df_clean["Total_HH"].eq(0)
    if not empty_mask.any():
        return df_clean.drop(columns=["GEOID_str", "Tract", "County", "Total_HH"])

    print(f"Found {int(empty_mask.sum()):,} block group(s) with 0 household-size controls. Cascading tract/county/region seeds.")
    tract_totals = df_clean.groupby("Tract")[size_cols].sum()
    county_totals = df_clean.groupby("County")[size_cols].sum()
    regional_totals = df_clean[size_cols].sum()

    for index, row in df_clean[empty_mask].iterrows():
        tract_id = row["Tract"]
        county_id = row["County"]
        if tract_id in tract_totals.index and tract_totals.loc[tract_id].sum() > 0:
            df_clean.loc[index, size_cols] = tract_totals.loc[tract_id].values
        elif county_id in county_totals.index and county_totals.loc[county_id].sum() > 0:
            print(f"Tract {tract_id} is empty. Seeding BG {row[geoid_col]} with county {county_id} distribution.")
            df_clean.loc[index, size_cols] = county_totals.loc[county_id].values
        else:
            print(f"County {county_id} is empty. Seeding BG {row[geoid_col]} with regional distribution.")
            df_clean.loc[index, size_cols] = regional_totals.values

    return df_clean.drop(columns=["GEOID_str", "Tract", "County", "Total_HH"])


def smooth_hhsize_donut_holes(df, size_cols, geoid_col="BlockGroup"):
    df_clean = df.copy()
    df_clean[size_cols] = df_clean[size_cols].fillna(0).clip(lower=0)
    df_clean["GEOID_str"] = df_clean[geoid_col].astype(str).str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(12)
    df_clean["Tract"] = df_clean["GEOID_str"].str[:11]
    df_clean["Total_HH"] = df_clean[size_cols].sum(axis=1)

    col_1, col_2, col_3, col_4, col_5, col_6p = size_cols
    sum_below_2 = df_clean[col_1]
    sum_below_3 = sum_below_2 + df_clean[col_2]
    sum_below_4 = sum_below_3 + df_clean[col_3]
    sum_below_5 = sum_below_4 + df_clean[col_4]
    sum_above_5 = df_clean[col_6p]
    sum_above_4 = sum_above_5 + df_clean[col_5]
    sum_above_3 = sum_above_4 + df_clean[col_4]
    sum_above_2 = sum_above_3 + df_clean[col_3]

    pct_threshold = 0.08
    min_households = 40
    dynamic_threshold = np.maximum(min_households, df_clean["Total_HH"] * pct_threshold)
    donut_2 = df_clean[col_2].eq(0) & sum_below_2.ge(dynamic_threshold) & sum_above_2.ge(dynamic_threshold)
    donut_3 = df_clean[col_3].eq(0) & sum_below_3.ge(dynamic_threshold) & sum_above_3.ge(dynamic_threshold)
    donut_4 = df_clean[col_4].eq(0) & sum_below_4.ge(dynamic_threshold) & sum_above_4.ge(dynamic_threshold)
    donut_5 = df_clean[col_5].eq(0) & sum_below_5.ge(dynamic_threshold) & sum_above_5.ge(dynamic_threshold)
    broken_mask = donut_2 | donut_3 | donut_4 | donut_5

    if not broken_mask.any():
        return df_clean.drop(columns=["GEOID_str", "Tract", "Total_HH"])

    print(f"Found {int(broken_mask.sum()):,} block group(s) with household-size donut holes. Applying tract smoothing.")
    tract_totals = df_clean.groupby("Tract")[size_cols].sum()
    tract_dist = tract_totals.div(tract_totals.sum(axis=1).replace(0, 1), axis=0)

    for index, row in df_clean[broken_mask].iterrows():
        tract_id = row["Tract"]
        total_hhs = int(row["Total_HH"])
        if total_hhs <= 0 or tract_id not in tract_dist.index or tract_totals.loc[tract_id].sum() <= 0:
            continue
        exact_values = total_hhs * tract_dist.loc[tract_id]
        smoothed_values = np.floor(exact_values).astype(int)
        diff = total_hhs - int(smoothed_values.sum())
        if diff > 0:
            remainders = exact_values - smoothed_values
            smoothed_values.loc[remainders.sort_values(ascending=False).head(diff).index] += 1
        elif diff < 0:
            subtract_index = smoothed_values[smoothed_values.gt(0)].sort_values(ascending=False).head(abs(diff)).index
            smoothed_values.loc[subtract_index] -= 1
        df_clean.loc[index, size_cols] = smoothed_values.values

    return df_clean.drop(columns=["GEOID_str", "Tract", "Total_HH"])

# 9.0) Build MAZ-level single-family and multifamily housing-unit controls
# Reader note: this cell implements the section described above and writes only the configured intermediate/final outputs.

file_date = RUN_DATE
output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"MAZ_SF_MF_HousingInventory_{file_date}.csv"
county_summary_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"MAZ_SF_MF_HousingInventory_county_summary_{file_date}.csv"
unmatched_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"MAZ_SF_MF_HousingInventory_unmatched_points_{file_date}.csv"

required_paths = {
    "MAZ shapefile": maz_shape_path,
    "Housing-unit centroid shapefile": housing_units_path,
}
missing_paths = [f"{name}: {path}" for name, path in required_paths.items() if not Path(path).exists()]
if missing_paths:
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Required input file(s) not found: {missing_paths}")

maz = gpd.read_file(maz_shape_path)
housing_units = gpd.read_file(housing_units_path)

required_maz_columns = {"maz_id", "CO_NAME", "geometry"}
required_housing_columns = {"APX_BLT_YR", "UNIT_COUNT", "BTYPE", "geometry"}
missing_maz_columns = sorted(required_maz_columns - set(maz.columns))
missing_housing_columns = sorted(required_housing_columns - set(housing_units.columns))
if missing_maz_columns:
    raise KeyError(f"MAZ shapefile is missing required column(s): {missing_maz_columns}")
if missing_housing_columns:
    raise KeyError(f"Housing-unit file is missing required column(s): {missing_housing_columns}")

maz = maz[["maz_id", "CO_NAME", "geometry"]].copy()
maz["maz_id"] = pd.to_numeric(maz["maz_id"], errors="coerce")
maz = maz.dropna(subset=["maz_id"]).copy()
maz["maz_id"] = maz["maz_id"].astype(int)
maz = maz.drop_duplicates(subset=["maz_id"])

housing_units = housing_units.to_crs(maz.crs)
housing_units = housing_units.dropna(subset=["geometry"]).copy()
housing_units = housing_units[~housing_units.geometry.is_empty].copy()
housing_units["APX_BLT_YR"] = pd.to_numeric(housing_units["APX_BLT_YR"], errors="coerce")
housing_units["UNIT_COUNT"] = pd.to_numeric(housing_units["UNIT_COUNT"], errors="coerce").fillna(0)
housing_units["BTYPE"] = pd.to_numeric(housing_units["BTYPE"], errors="coerce")

housing_units = housing_units[
    housing_units["APX_BLT_YR"].le(int(YEAR))
    & housing_units["UNIT_COUNT"].gt(0)
].copy()
housing_units["building_type"] = np.where(housing_units["BTYPE"].eq(1), "SF", "MF")

matched_units = gpd.sjoin(
    housing_units[["APX_BLT_YR", "UNIT_COUNT", "BTYPE", "building_type", "geometry"]],
    maz[["maz_id", "CO_NAME", "geometry"]],
    how="left",
    predicate="within",
).drop(columns=["index_right"], errors="ignore")

unmatched_units = matched_units[matched_units["maz_id"].isna()].copy()
if not unmatched_units.empty:
    unmatched_units.drop(columns="geometry", errors="ignore").to_csv(unmatched_output_path, index=False)

matched_units = matched_units.dropna(subset=["maz_id"]).copy()
matched_units["maz_id"] = matched_units["maz_id"].astype(int)

maz_housing = (
    matched_units.groupby(["maz_id", "building_type"], as_index=False)["UNIT_COUNT"]
    .sum()
    .pivot(index="maz_id", columns="building_type", values="UNIT_COUNT")
    .fillna(0)
    .reset_index()
)

for column in ["SF", "MF"]:
    if column not in maz_housing.columns:
        maz_housing[column] = 0

maz_housing = maz[["maz_id", "CO_NAME"]].merge(
    maz_housing[["maz_id", "SF", "MF"]],
    on="maz_id",
    how="left",
)
maz_housing[["SF", "MF"]] = maz_housing[["SF", "MF"]].fillna(0).round().astype(int)
maz_housing["TOTAL_HU"] = maz_housing["SF"] + maz_housing["MF"]
maz_housing = maz_housing[["maz_id", "CO_NAME", "SF", "MF", "TOTAL_HU"]].sort_values("maz_id")

county_summary = (
    maz_housing.groupby("CO_NAME", as_index=False)[["SF", "MF", "TOTAL_HU"]]
    .sum()
    .sort_values("CO_NAME")
)

source_unit_total = int(housing_units["UNIT_COUNT"].sum())
matched_unit_total = int(matched_units["UNIT_COUNT"].sum())
unmatched_unit_total = source_unit_total - matched_unit_total

maz_housing.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
county_summary.to_csv(county_summary_path, index=False)

print(f"Saved MAZ housing inventory: {output_path}")
print(f"Saved county summary: {county_summary_path}")
print(f"MAZs: {len(maz_housing):,}")
print(f"MAZs with housing units: {maz_housing['TOTAL_HU'].gt(0).sum():,}")
print(f"Source housing units: {source_unit_total:,}")
print(f"Matched housing units: {matched_unit_total:,}")
print(f"Unmatched housing units: {unmatched_unit_total:,}")
if unmatched_unit_total:
    print(f"WARNING: Unmatched housing-unit points were saved for review: {unmatched_output_path}")

county_summary

def fetch_block_group_vacancy_data(max_attempts=3):
    params = {
        "get": ",".join(api_fields),
        "for": "block group:*",
        "in": f"state:{state_code} county:* tract:*",
        "key": API_KEY,
    }

    for attempt in range(1, max_attempts + 1):
        try:
            response = requests.get(base_url, params=params, timeout=(10, 180))
            if response.status_code == 204:
                raise ValueError("No ACS block group vacancy data returned.")
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            return pd.DataFrame(data[1:], columns=data[0])
        except (requests.exceptions.RequestException, ValueError) as error:
            if attempt == max_attempts:
                raise RuntimeError(f"ACS block group vacancy request failed after {max_attempts} attempts.") from error
            wait_seconds = 5 * attempt
            print(f"ACS vacancy request failed on attempt {attempt}; retrying in {wait_seconds} seconds...")
            time.sleep(wait_seconds)

    raise RuntimeError("ACS block group vacancy request failed.")

    )


def allocate_capped_integer_total(df, group_column, weight_column, target_column, capacity_column, output_column):
    pieces = []
    for group_value, group in df.groupby(group_column, sort=False):
        group = group.copy()
        requested_total = int(group[target_column].iloc[0])
        capacity = np.floor(
            pd.to_numeric(group[capacity_column], errors="coerce").fillna(0).clip(lower=0)
        ).astype(int)
        weights = pd.to_numeric(group[weight_column], errors="coerce").fillna(0).clip(lower=0)
        if weights.sum() <= 0:
            weights = capacity.astype(float)

        feasible_total = int(capacity.sum())
        target_total = min(requested_total, feasible_total)
        if requested_total > feasible_total:
            print(
                "WARNING: "
                f"County {group_value} TOTHH ({requested_total:,}) exceeds MAZ housing-unit capacity "
                f"({feasible_total:,}). HHBASE was capped at available units."
            )

        allocation = pd.Series(0, index=group.index, dtype=int)
        remaining_capacity = capacity.copy()
        remaining_total = target_total

        while remaining_total > 0 and remaining_capacity.sum() > 0:
            active = remaining_capacity.gt(0)
            active_weights = weights[active]
            if active_weights.sum() <= 0:
                active_weights = remaining_capacity[active].astype(float)

            exact_add = remaining_total * active_weights / active_weights.sum()
            integer_add = np.floor(exact_add).astype(int)
            integer_add = np.minimum(integer_add, remaining_capacity[active])

            if integer_add.sum() == 0:
                priority = exact_add.sort_values(ascending=False).index
                slots_to_fill = min(remaining_total, len(priority))
                integer_add.loc[priority[:slots_to_fill]] = 1

            allocation.loc[integer_add.index] += integer_add
            remaining_capacity.loc[integer_add.index] -= integer_add
            remaining_total = target_total - int(allocation.sum())

        group[output_column] = allocation.astype(int)
        pieces.append(group)

    return pd.concat(pieces, ignore_index=True)

missing_geography_columns = sorted(required_geography_columns - set(maz_geography.columns))

    raise KeyError(f"MAZ housing inventory is missing required column(s): {missing_housing_columns}")
if missing_county_columns:
    raise KeyError(f"County controls are missing required column(s): {missing_county_columns}")
if missing_geography_columns:
    raise KeyError(f"MAZ geography crosswalk is missing required column(s): {missing_geography_columns}")

housing["maz_id"] = pd.to_numeric(housing["maz_id"], errors="coerce")
housing["SF_UNITS"] = pd.to_numeric(housing["SF"], errors="coerce").fillna(0).clip(lower=0)
housing["MF_UNITS"] = pd.to_numeric(housing["MF"], errors="coerce").fillna(0).clip(lower=0)
housing["TOTAL_HU"] = pd.to_numeric(housing["TOTAL_HU"], errors="coerce").fillna(0).clip(lower=0)
housing = housing.dropna(subset=["maz_id"]).copy()
housing["maz_id"] = housing["maz_id"].astype(int)

source_maz_count = len(housing)
housing = housing[housing["TOTAL_HU"].gt(0)].copy()
zero_unit_maz_count = source_maz_count - len(housing)
if zero_unit_maz_count:
    print(f"Filtered out {zero_unit_maz_count:,} MAZ record(s) with TOTAL_HU <= 0.")

missing_co_name = housing[housing["CO_NAME"].isna() | housing["CO_NAME"].astype(str).str.strip().eq("")].copy()
if not missing_co_name.empty:
    print(
        "WARNING: "
        f"{len(missing_co_name):,} MAZ record(s) with TOTAL_HU > 0 are missing CO_NAME and will be excluded. "
        f"Example MAZs: {missing_co_name['maz_id'].head().astype(int).tolist()}"
    )

housing = housing[housing["CO_NAME"].notna() & ~housing["CO_NAME"].astype(str).str.strip().eq("")].copy()
print(f"MAZ records kept with TOTAL_HU > 0 and valid CO_NAME: {len(housing):,}")
housing["TOTAL_UNITS"] = housing["SF_UNITS"] + housing["MF_UNITS"]

maz_geography = maz_geography.dropna(subset=["maz_id", "BlockGroup"]).copy()
maz_geography["maz_id"] = maz_geography["maz_id"].astype(int)
maz_geography["BlockGroup"] = maz_geography["BlockGroup"].astype(str).str.zfill(12)

county_controls["county_fips"] = county_controls["county_fips"].astype(str).str.zfill(3)

vacancy["state"] = vacancy["state"].astype(str).str.zfill(2)

vacancy["block group"] = vacancy["block group"].astype(str).str.zfill(1)
vacancy["BlockGroup"] = vacancy["state"] + vacancy["county"] + vacancy["tract"] + vacancy["block group"]
vacancy["county_fips"] = vacancy["county"]

target_county_fips = set(county_controls["county_fips"])
target_block_groups = set(maz_geography["BlockGroup"].dropna())
vacancy = vacancy[
    vacancy["county_fips"].isin(target_county_fips)
    & vacancy["BlockGroup"].isin(target_block_groups)
].copy()
vacancy[vacancy_variables] = vacancy[vacancy_variables].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0)
market_vacancy_cap = 0.15
vacancy["total_housing_units_acs"] = vacancy["B25002_001E"]
vacancy["occupied_units_acs"] = vacancy["B25002_002E"]
vacancy["vacant_units_acs"] = vacancy["B25002_003E"]
vacancy["vacant_forrent"] = vacancy["B25004_002E"]
vacancy["vacant_forsale"] = vacancy["B25004_004E"]
vacancy["vacant_seasonal"] = vacancy["B25004_006E"]
vacancy["market_units"] = (vacancy["total_housing_units_acs"] - vacancy["vacant_seasonal"]).clip(lower=0)
vacancy["market_vacant_units"] = (vacancy["vacant_units_acs"] - vacancy["vacant_seasonal"]).clip(lower=0)
vacancy["market_vacancy_rate"] = np.where(
    vacancy["market_units"].gt(0),
    vacancy["market_vacant_units"] / vacancy["market_units"],
    0,
)
vacancy["capped_market_vacancy_rate"] = vacancy["market_vacancy_rate"].clip(upper=market_vacancy_cap)
vacancy["effective_vacant_units"] = (
    vacancy["vacant_seasonal"]
    + vacancy["market_units"] * vacancy["capped_market_vacancy_rate"]
)
vacancy["bg_vacancy_rate"] = np.where(
    vacancy["total_housing_units_acs"].gt(0),
    vacancy["effective_vacant_units"] / vacancy["total_housing_units_acs"],
    0,
)
vacancy["bg_vacancy_rate"] = vacancy["bg_vacancy_rate"].clip(lower=0, upper=1)
vacancy = vacancy[[
    "BlockGroup",
    "county_fips",
    "NAME",
    "total_housing_units_acs",
    "occupied_units_acs",
    "vacant_units_acs",
    "vacant_forrent",
    "vacant_forsale",
    "vacant_seasonal",
    "market_units",
    "market_vacant_units",
    "market_vacancy_rate",
    "capped_market_vacancy_rate",
    "effective_vacant_units",
    "bg_vacancy_rate",
]].sort_values(["county_fips", "BlockGroup"])
vacancy.to_csv(vacancy_rate_output_path, index=False)

vacancy_review = vacancy.merge(
    county_controls[["county_fips", "county_name"]].drop_duplicates(),
    on="county_fips",
    how="left",
)
print("Block group vacancy rates before fixed-vacancy overrides:")
print(
    vacancy_review.groupby(["county_fips", "county_name"], dropna=False)
    .agg(
        block_groups=("BlockGroup", "count"),
        total_housing_units_acs=("total_housing_units_acs", "sum"),
        effective_vacant_units=("effective_vacant_units", "sum"),
        min_bg_vacancy_rate=("bg_vacancy_rate", "min"),
        mean_bg_vacancy_rate=("bg_vacancy_rate", "mean"),
        max_bg_vacancy_rate=("bg_vacancy_rate", "max"),
    )
    .reset_index()
    .round(4)
    .to_string(index=False)
)
print("Highest block group vacancy rates before fixed-vacancy overrides:")
print(
    vacancy_review[[
        "BlockGroup",
        "county_name",
        "total_housing_units_acs",
        "vacant_units_acs",
        "vacant_seasonal",
        "market_vacancy_rate",
        "capped_market_vacancy_rate",
        "bg_vacancy_rate",
    ]]
    .sort_values("bg_vacancy_rate", ascending=False)
    .head(20)
    .round(4)
    .to_string(index=False)
)

high_bg_vacancy = vacancy_review[vacancy_review["bg_vacancy_rate"].gt(0.50)].copy()
if not high_bg_vacancy.empty:
    high_bg_vacancy["seasonal_share_of_total_hu"] = np.where(
        high_bg_vacancy["total_housing_units_acs"].gt(0),
        high_bg_vacancy["vacant_seasonal"] / high_bg_vacancy["total_housing_units_acs"],
        0,
    )
    print(
        "WARNING: "
        f"{len(high_bg_vacancy):,} block group(s) have pre-fixed vacancy rates above 50%. "
        "These are usually caused by high seasonal-vacant shares or small ACS housing-unit denominators."
    )
    print(
        high_bg_vacancy[[
            "BlockGroup",
            "county_name",
            "total_housing_units_acs",
            "vacant_units_acs",
            "vacant_seasonal",
            "seasonal_share_of_total_hu",
            "market_vacancy_rate",
            "capped_market_vacancy_rate",
            "bg_vacancy_rate",
        ]]
        .sort_values("bg_vacancy_rate", ascending=False)
        .head(20)
        .round(4)
        .to_string(index=False)
    )

controls = controls.drop(columns=["county_name", "TOTHH"], errors="ignore")

if fixed_vacancy_path.exists():

    fixed_vacancy.columns = fixed_vacancy.columns.str.strip()

    fixed_vacancy = fixed_vacancy[["maz_id", "fixed_vac"]].copy()

    fixed_vacancy = fixed_vacancy.dropna(subset=["maz_id", "fixed_vac"]).copy()
    fixed_vacancy["maz_id"] = fixed_vacancy["maz_id"].astype(int)
    fixed_vacancy["fixed_vac"] = np.where(fixed_vacancy["fixed_vac"].gt(1), fixed_vacancy["fixed_vac"] / 100, fixed_vacancy["fixed_vac"])

missing_county_controls = controls[controls["TOTHH"].isna()][["maz_id", "CO_NAME", "county_fips_from_geo", "county_key"]].drop_duplicates()

controls["TOTAL_CAPACITY"] = controls["SF_CAPACITY"] + controls["MF_CAPACITY"]

controls.loc[mf_over_capacity, "SF"] += controls.loc[mf_over_capacity, "MF"] - controls.loc[mf_over_capacity, "MF_CAPACITY"]

controls["MF"] = controls["HHBASE"] - controls["SF"]
controls[["SF", "MF", "HHBASE"]] = controls[["SF", "MF", "HHBASE"]].astype(int)

    controls["HHBASE"].gt(controls["TOTAL_CAPACITY"])
    | controls["SF"].gt(controls["SF_CAPACITY"])
    | controls["MF"].gt(controls["MF_CAPACITY"])
    | controls[["SF", "MF", "HHBASE"]].lt(0).any(axis=1)
]

    1 - controls["SF"] / controls["SF_CAPACITY"],

)

    1 - controls["MF"] / controls["MF_CAPACITY"],
    np.nan,
)
controls["TOTAL_FINAL_VAC_RATE"] = np.where(
    controls["TOTAL_CAPACITY"].gt(0),
    1 - controls["HHBASE"] / controls["TOTAL_CAPACITY"],
    np.nan,
)
controls[["SF_FINAL_VAC_RATE", "MF_FINAL_VAC_RATE", "TOTAL_FINAL_VAC_RATE"]] = controls[[
    "SF_FINAL_VAC_RATE",
    "MF_FINAL_VAC_RATE",
    "TOTAL_FINAL_VAC_RATE",
]].clip(lower=0, upper=1)

output = controls[["maz_id", "SF", "MF", "HHBASE"]].sort_values("maz_id")

    "county_fips",

    "MF",

    "SF_FINAL_VAC_RATE",

]].sort_values("maz_id")

)

def allocate_integer_total_by_group(df, group_column, weight_column, target_column, output_column):
    pieces = []
    for group_value, group in df.groupby(group_column, sort=False):
        group = group.copy()
        target_total = int(group[target_column].iloc[0])
        weights = pd.to_numeric(group[weight_column], errors="coerce").fillna(0).clip(lower=0)
        if weights.sum() <= 0:
            weights = pd.to_numeric(group["HHBASE"], errors="coerce").fillna(0).clip(lower=0)
        if weights.sum() <= 0 or target_total <= 0:
            group[output_column] = 0
            pieces.append(group)
            continue

        exact_values = target_total * weights / weights.sum()
        integer_values = np.floor(exact_values).astype(int)
        remainder = exact_values - integer_values
        difference = target_total - int(integer_values.sum())

        if difference > 0:
            integer_values.loc[remainder.sort_values(ascending=False).head(difference).index] += 1
        elif difference < 0:
            subtract_index = remainder[integer_values.gt(0)].sort_values(ascending=True).head(abs(difference)).index
            integer_values.loc[subtract_index] -= 1

        group[output_column] = integer_values.astype(int)
        pieces.append(group)

    return pd.concat(pieces, ignore_index=True)


def allocate_household_size_mix(row, share_columns, output_columns, total_column="HHBASE"):
    total = int(row[total_column])
    if total <= 0:
        return pd.Series({column: 0 for column in output_columns})

    shares = row[share_columns].astype(float).clip(lower=0)
    if shares.sum() <= 0:
        shares = pd.Series(1 / len(share_columns), index=share_columns)
    else:
        shares = shares / shares.sum()

    exact_values = total * shares
    integer_values = np.floor(exact_values).astype(int)
    difference = total - int(integer_values.sum())
    if difference > 0:
        integer_values.loc[(exact_values - integer_values).sort_values(ascending=False).head(difference).index] += 1

    integer_values.index = output_columns
    return integer_values.astype(int)


def clean_geoid(series, width):
    return series.astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(width)


def build_missing_maz_geography_from_shapes(missing_maz_ids):
    missing_maz_ids = sorted(set(int(maz_id) for maz_id in missing_maz_ids))
    if not missing_maz_ids:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=["maz_id", "BlockGroup", "county_fips"])

    required_repair_paths = {
        "MAZ shapefile": maz_shape_path,
        "Block group shapefile": block_group_shapefile_path,
    }
    missing_repair_paths = [f"{name}: {path}" for name, path in required_repair_paths.items() if not Path(path).exists()]
    if missing_repair_paths:
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            "Cannot repair missing MAZ geography because required shapefile(s) are missing: "
            f"{missing_repair_paths}"
        )

    maz_polygons = gpd.read_file(maz_shape_path)
    block_groups = gpd.read_file(block_group_shapefile_path).to_crs(maz_polygons.crs)
    required_maz_columns = {"maz_id", "geometry"}
    required_bg_columns = {"GEOID", "geometry"}
    missing_maz_columns = sorted(required_maz_columns - set(maz_polygons.columns))
    missing_bg_columns = sorted(required_bg_columns - set(block_groups.columns))
    if missing_maz_columns:
        raise KeyError(f"MAZ shapefile is missing required column(s): {missing_maz_columns}")
    if missing_bg_columns:
        raise KeyError(f"Block group shapefile is missing required column(s): {missing_bg_columns}")

    maz_polygons = maz_polygons[["maz_id", "geometry"]].dropna(subset=["maz_id", "geometry"]).copy()
    maz_polygons["maz_id"] = pd.to_numeric(maz_polygons["maz_id"], errors="coerce")
    maz_polygons = maz_polygons.dropna(subset=["maz_id"]).copy()
    maz_polygons["maz_id"] = maz_polygons["maz_id"].astype(int)
    maz_polygons = maz_polygons[maz_polygons["maz_id"].isin(missing_maz_ids)].drop_duplicates(subset=["maz_id"])
    if maz_polygons.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=["maz_id", "BlockGroup", "county_fips"])

    block_groups = block_groups[["GEOID", "geometry"]].copy()
    block_groups["BlockGroup"] = clean_geoid(block_groups["GEOID"], 12)
    maz_points = maz_polygons[["maz_id", "geometry"]].copy()
    maz_points["geometry"] = maz_points.geometry.representative_point()
    repaired = gpd.sjoin(
        maz_points,
        block_groups[["BlockGroup", "geometry"]],
        how="left",
        predicate="within",
    ).drop(columns=["geometry", "index_right"], errors="ignore")
    repaired = pd.DataFrame(repaired).dropna(subset=["maz_id", "BlockGroup"]).copy()
    repaired["maz_id"] = repaired["maz_id"].astype(int)
    repaired["BlockGroup"] = repaired["BlockGroup"].astype(str).str.zfill(12)
    repaired["county_fips"] = repaired["BlockGroup"].str[2:5]
    return repaired[["maz_id", "BlockGroup", "county_fips"]].drop_duplicates(subset=["maz_id"])


def load_county_hhsize_6p_multipliers(seed_path, fallback_multiplier):
    seed = pd.read_csv(seed_path, usecols=["PUMA", "NP", "WGTP"])
    missing_seed_columns = sorted({"PUMA", "NP", "WGTP"} - set(seed.columns))
    if missing_seed_columns:
        raise KeyError(f"PUMS household seed is missing required column(s): {missing_seed_columns}")

    seed["PUMA"] = pd.to_numeric(seed["PUMA"], errors="coerce")
    seed["NP"] = pd.to_numeric(seed["NP"], errors="coerce")
    seed["WGTP"] = pd.to_numeric(seed["WGTP"], errors="coerce").fillna(0)
    seed = seed.dropna(subset=["PUMA", "NP"]).copy()
    seed = seed[seed["WGTP"].gt(0) & seed["NP"].ge(6)].copy()
    if seed.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=["county_fips", "HHSIZE6P_PERSON_FACTOR", "PUMS_6P_HOUSEHOLDS", "PUMS_6P_PERSONS"])

    seed["county_fips"] = (seed["PUMA"].astype(int) // 1000).astype(str).str.zfill(3)
    seed["weighted_persons"] = seed["NP"] * seed["WGTP"]
    multipliers = (
        seed.groupby("county_fips", as_index=False)
        .agg(
            PUMS_6P_HOUSEHOLDS=("WGTP", "sum"),
            PUMS_6P_PERSONS=("weighted_persons", "sum"),
        )
    )
    multipliers["HHSIZE6P_PERSON_FACTOR"] = np.where(
        multipliers["PUMS_6P_HOUSEHOLDS"].gt(0),
        multipliers["PUMS_6P_PERSONS"] / multipliers["PUMS_6P_HOUSEHOLDS"],
        fallback_multiplier,
    )
    return multipliers[["county_fips", "HHSIZE6P_PERSON_FACTOR", "PUMS_6P_HOUSEHOLDS", "PUMS_6P_PERSONS"]]

county_hhsize_6p_multipliers = load_county_hhsize_6p_multipliers(pums_household_seed_path, hhsize_6p_multiplier)

required_maz_columns = {"maz_id", "HHBASE"}

missing_maz_columns = sorted(required_maz_columns - set(maz_households.columns))

missing_hhsize_columns = sorted(required_hhsize_columns - set(household_size.columns))
missing_geography_columns = sorted(required_geography_columns - set(maz_geography.columns))
if missing_maz_columns:

if missing_county_columns:
    raise KeyError(f"County controls are missing required column(s): {missing_county_columns}")
if missing_hhsize_columns:
    raise KeyError(f"Household-size controls are missing required column(s): {missing_hhsize_columns}")
if missing_geography_columns:
    raise KeyError(f"MAZ geography crosswalk is missing required column(s): {missing_geography_columns}")

maz_households["maz_id"] = pd.to_numeric(maz_households["maz_id"], errors="coerce")
maz_households["HHBASE"] = pd.to_numeric(maz_households["HHBASE"], errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)
maz_households = maz_households.dropna(subset=["maz_id"]).copy()
maz_households["maz_id"] = maz_households["maz_id"].astype(int)

maz_geography = maz_geography.dropna(subset=["maz_id", "BlockGroup"]).copy()
maz_geography["maz_id"] = maz_geography["maz_id"].astype(int)

        + household_size["HHSIZE6P"] * household_size["HHSIZE6P_PERSON_FACTOR"]

missing_geography = maz[maz["BlockGroup"].isna()][["maz_id", "HHBASE"]]

if not remaining_missing_geography.empty:

file_date = RUN_DATE
acs_year = YEAR

child_presence_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_ChildPresenceControlsBG_{file_date}.csv"
audit_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"MAZ_Person_Controls_audit_{file_date}.csv"
haschild_regional_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"bghouseholds_Regional_HASCHILD_distributed_{file_date}.csv"
haschild_county_filename_template = "bghouseholds_{county_name}_HASCHILD_distributed_" + f"{file_date}.csv"
haschild_validation_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"BG_HASCHILD_distribution_validation_{file_date}.csv"

required_paths = [child_presence_path, audit_output_path]
missing_paths = [path for path in required_paths if not Path(path).exists()]
if missing_paths:
    raise FileNotFoundError("Run cells 5.0 and 13.0 first. Missing:\n" + "\n".join(map(str, missing_paths)))

def normalize_blockgroup(series: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    return series.astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(12)

def allocate_binary_by_shares(row, yes_share_col="HHCHILD_SHARE", total_col="HHBASE"):
    total = int(row[total_col])
    if total <= 0:
        return pd.Series({"HASCHILD_YES": 0, "HASCHILD_NO": 0})

    yes_share = row[yes_share_col]
    if pd.isna(yes_share):
        yes_share = 0.0
    yes_share = min(max(float(yes_share), 0.0), 1.0)
    yes = int(np.floor(total * yes_share))
    remainder = total * yes_share - yes
    if remainder >= 0.5:
        yes += 1
    yes = min(max(yes, 0), total)
    return pd.Series({"HASCHILD_YES": yes, "HASCHILD_NO": total - yes})

child_controls = pd.read_csv(child_presence_path, dtype={"BlockGroup": "string"})
child_controls.columns = [column.strip() for column in child_controls.columns]
child_controls["BlockGroup"] = normalize_blockgroup(child_controls["BlockGroup"])
for column in ["HHCHILD", "HHNOCHILD", "HHBASE"]:
    child_controls[column] = pd.to_numeric(child_controls[column], errors="coerce").fillna(0).clip(lower=0)

child_controls["HHBASE"] = child_controls[["HHCHILD", "HHNOCHILD"]].sum(axis=1)
child_controls["HHCHILD_SHARE"] = np.where(
    child_controls["HHBASE"].gt(0),
    child_controls["HHCHILD"] / child_controls["HHBASE"],
    np.nan,
)

if "maz" in globals() and {"maz_id", "BlockGroup", "county_fips", "county_name", "HHBASE"}.issubset(set(maz.columns)):
    maz_child = maz[["maz_id", "BlockGroup", "county_fips", "county_name", "HHBASE"]].copy()
else:
    maz_child = pd.read_csv(audit_output_path, dtype={"maz_id": "Int64", "BlockGroup": "string", "county_fips": "string"})[
        ["maz_id", "BlockGroup", "county_fips", "county_name", "HHBASE"]
    ].copy()

maz_child["BlockGroup"] = normalize_blockgroup(maz_child["BlockGroup"])
maz_child["county_fips"] = maz_child["county_fips"].astype(str).str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(3)
maz_child["HHBASE"] = pd.to_numeric(maz_child["HHBASE"], errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)
maz_child = maz_child.merge(child_controls[["BlockGroup", "HHCHILD_SHARE"]], on="BlockGroup", how="left")

missing_child_controls = maz_child[maz_child["HHCHILD_SHARE"].isna()][["maz_id", "BlockGroup", "HHBASE"]]
if not missing_child_controls.empty:
    county_share = (
        child_controls.assign(county_fips=child_controls["BlockGroup"].str[2:5])
        .groupby("county_fips", as_index=False)[["HHCHILD", "HHBASE"]]
        .sum()
    )
    county_share["COUNTY_HHCHILD_SHARE"] = np.where(
        county_share["HHBASE"].gt(0),
        county_share["HHCHILD"] / county_share["HHBASE"],
        np.nan,
    )
    regional_share = child_controls["HHCHILD"].sum() / child_controls["HHBASE"].sum()
    maz_child = maz_child.merge(county_share[["county_fips", "COUNTY_HHCHILD_SHARE"]], on="county_fips", how="left")
    maz_child["HHCHILD_SHARE"] = maz_child["HHCHILD_SHARE"].fillna(maz_child["COUNTY_HHCHILD_SHARE"]).fillna(regional_share)
    print(f"Filled child-presence shares for {len(missing_child_controls):,} MAZ record(s) without BG child controls.")

maz_child[["HASCHILD_YES", "HASCHILD_NO"]] = maz_child.apply(allocate_binary_by_shares, axis=1)
maz_child["HASCHILD_TOTAL"] = maz_child["HASCHILD_YES"] + maz_child["HASCHILD_NO"]
if not maz_child["HASCHILD_TOTAL"].eq(maz_child["HHBASE"]).all():
    bad_rows = maz_child[~maz_child["HASCHILD_TOTAL"].eq(maz_child["HHBASE"])][["maz_id", "HHBASE", "HASCHILD_TOTAL"]]
    raise ValueError(f"HASCHILD allocation does not sum to HHBASE: {bad_rows.head().to_dict('records')}")

bg_haschild_output = (
    maz_child.groupby(["BlockGroup", "county_fips", "county_name"], as_index=False)[["HASCHILD_YES", "HASCHILD_NO"]]
    .sum()
    .sort_values("BlockGroup")
)
bg_haschild_output["hhs"] = bg_haschild_output["HASCHILD_YES"] + bg_haschild_output["HASCHILD_NO"]
output_columns = ["BlockGroup", "hhs", "HASCHILD_YES", "HASCHILD_NO"]
for column in ["hhs", "HASCHILD_YES", "HASCHILD_NO"]:
    bg_haschild_output[column] = bg_haschild_output[column].astype(int)

haschild_validation = bg_haschild_output.merge(
    child_controls[["BlockGroup", "HHCHILD", "HHNOCHILD", "HHBASE"]].rename(columns={
        "HHCHILD": "ACS_HHCHILD",
        "HHNOCHILD": "ACS_HHNOCHILD",
        "HHBASE": "ACS_HHBASE",
    }),
    on="BlockGroup",
    how="left",
)
haschild_validation["HHS_MINUS_HASCHILD"] = haschild_validation["hhs"] - haschild_validation[["HASCHILD_YES", "HASCHILD_NO"]].sum(axis=1)
haschild_validation["HHS_MINUS_ACS_HHBASE"] = haschild_validation["hhs"] - haschild_validation["ACS_HHBASE"].fillna(0)

bg_haschild_output[output_columns].to_csv(haschild_regional_output_path, index=False)
haschild_county_paths = []
for (county_fips, county_name), county_rows in bg_haschild_output.groupby(["county_fips", "county_name"], sort=True):
    county_path = OUTPUT_DIR / haschild_county_filename_template.format(county_name=county_name)
    county_rows[output_columns].to_csv(county_path, index=False)
    haschild_county_paths.append(county_path)
haschild_validation.to_csv(haschild_validation_path, index=False)

print(f"Saved regional BG has-child controls: {haschild_regional_output_path}")
print("Saved county BG has-child controls:")
for county_path in haschild_county_paths:
    print(f"  {county_path}")
print(f"Saved has-child validation: {haschild_validation_path}")
print(f"Regional households: {bg_haschild_output['hhs'].sum():,}")
print(f"Regional has-child households: {bg_haschild_output['HASCHILD_YES'].sum():,}")
print(f"Regional no-child households: {bg_haschild_output['HASCHILD_NO'].sum():,}")

# 16.0) Distribute households by household income
# Reader note: this cell implements the section described above and writes only the configured intermediate/final outputs.


file_date = RUN_DATE
acs_year = YEAR

income_control_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_IncomeControlsBG_{file_date}.csv"
audit_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"MAZ_Person_Controls_audit_{file_date}.csv"
income_regional_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"bghouseholds_Regional_HHINC_distributed_{file_date}.csv"
income_county_filename_template = "bghouseholds_{county_name}_HHINC_distributed_" + f"{file_date}.csv"
income_validation_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"BG_HHINC_distribution_validation_{file_date}.csv"

income_columns = [
    "HHINC000_025",
    "HHINC025_050",
    "HHINC050_075",
    "HHINC075_100",
    "HHINC100_125",
    "HHINC125_150",
    "HHINC150_200",
    "HHINC200P",
]

required_paths = [income_control_path, audit_output_path]
missing_paths = [path for path in required_paths if not Path(path).exists()]
if missing_paths:
    raise FileNotFoundError("Run cells 7.0 and 13.0 first. Missing:\n" + "\n".join(map(str, missing_paths)))

def normalize_blockgroup(series: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    return series.astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(12)

def smooth_donut_holes_dynamic(df, value_cols, geoid_col="BlockGroup", pct_threshold=0.1, min_households=50):
    df_clean = df.copy()
    df_clean[value_cols] = df_clean[value_cols].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0).clip(lower=0)
    df_clean["GEOID_str"] = normalize_blockgroup(df_clean[geoid_col])
    df_clean["Tract"] = df_clean["GEOID_str"].str[:11]
    df_clean["Total_HH"] = df_clean[value_cols].sum(axis=1)

    threshold = np.maximum(min_households, df_clean["Total_HH"] * pct_threshold)
    broken_mask = pd.Series(False, index=df_clean.index)
    for idx, column in enumerate(value_cols[1:-1], start=1):
        lower_sum = df_clean[value_cols[:idx]].sum(axis=1)
        upper_sum = df_clean[value_cols[idx + 1:]].sum(axis=1)
        broken_mask = broken_mask | (df_clean[column].eq(0) & lower_sum.ge(threshold) & upper_sum.ge(threshold))

    if not broken_mask.any():
        return df_clean.drop(columns=["GEOID_str", "Tract", "Total_HH"])

    print(
        f"Found {int(broken_mask.sum()):,} block group(s) with household-income donut holes. "
        f"Applying tract smoothing with pct_threshold={pct_threshold} and min_households={min_households}."
    )
    tract_totals = df_clean.groupby("Tract")[value_cols].sum()
    tract_dist = tract_totals.div(tract_totals.sum(axis=1).replace(0, 1), axis=0)

    for index, row in df_clean[broken_mask].iterrows():
        tract_id = row["Tract"]
        total_hhs = int(row["Total_HH"])
        if total_hhs <= 0 or tract_id not in tract_dist.index or tract_totals.loc[tract_id].sum() <= 0:
            continue
        exact_values = total_hhs * tract_dist.loc[tract_id]
        smoothed_values = np.floor(exact_values).astype(int)
        diff = total_hhs - int(smoothed_values.sum())
        if diff > 0:
            remainders = exact_values - smoothed_values
            smoothed_values.loc[remainders.sort_values(ascending=False).head(diff).index] += 1
        elif diff < 0:
            subtract_index = smoothed_values[smoothed_values.gt(0)].sort_values(ascending=False).head(abs(diff)).index
            smoothed_values.loc[subtract_index] -= 1
        df_clean.loc[index, value_cols] = smoothed_values.values

    return df_clean.drop(columns=["GEOID_str", "Tract", "Total_HH"])

def allocate_income_mix(row, share_columns, output_columns, total_column="HHBASE"):
    total = int(row[total_column])
    if total <= 0:
        return pd.Series({column: 0 for column in output_columns})

    shares = row[share_columns].astype(float).clip(lower=0)
    if shares.sum() <= 0:
        shares = pd.Series(1 / len(share_columns), index=share_columns)
    else:
        shares = shares / shares.sum()

    exact_values = total * shares
    integer_values = np.floor(exact_values).astype(int)
    diff = total - int(integer_values.sum())
    if diff > 0:
        remainders = exact_values - integer_values
        integer_values.loc[remainders.sort_values(ascending=False).head(diff).index] += 1
    elif diff < 0:
        subtract_index = integer_values[integer_values.gt(0)].sort_values(ascending=False).head(abs(diff)).index
        integer_values.loc[subtract_index] -= 1

    integer_values.index = output_columns
    return integer_values.astype(int)

income_controls = pd.read_csv(income_control_path, dtype={"BlockGroup": "string"})
income_controls.columns = [column.strip() for column in income_controls.columns]
missing_income_columns = sorted(set(["BlockGroup", *income_columns]) - set(income_controls.columns))
if missing_income_columns:
    raise KeyError(f"Income controls are missing required column(s): {missing_income_columns}")

income_controls["BlockGroup"] = normalize_blockgroup(income_controls["BlockGroup"])
income_controls[income_columns] = income_controls[income_columns].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0).clip(lower=0)
income_controls = smooth_donut_holes_dynamic(
    income_controls,
    income_columns,
    geoid_col="BlockGroup",
    pct_threshold=0.1,
    min_households=50,
)
income_controls["ACS_HHINC_TOTAL"] = income_controls[income_columns].sum(axis=1)
for column in income_columns:
    income_controls[f"{column}_SHARE"] = np.where(
        income_controls["ACS_HHINC_TOTAL"].gt(0),
        income_controls[column] / income_controls["ACS_HHINC_TOTAL"],
        np.nan,
    )

if "maz" in globals() and {"maz_id", "BlockGroup", "county_fips", "county_name", "HHBASE"}.issubset(set(maz.columns)):
    maz_income = maz[["maz_id", "BlockGroup", "county_fips", "county_name", "HHBASE"]].copy()
else:
    maz_income = pd.read_csv(audit_output_path, dtype={"maz_id": "Int64", "BlockGroup": "string", "county_fips": "string"})[
        ["maz_id", "BlockGroup", "county_fips", "county_name", "HHBASE"]
    ].copy()

maz_income["BlockGroup"] = normalize_blockgroup(maz_income["BlockGroup"])
maz_income["county_fips"] = maz_income["county_fips"].astype(str).str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(3)
maz_income["HHBASE"] = pd.to_numeric(maz_income["HHBASE"], errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)
share_columns = [f"{column}_SHARE" for column in income_columns]
maz_income = maz_income.merge(income_controls[["BlockGroup", "ACS_HHINC_TOTAL", *share_columns]], on="BlockGroup", how="left")

missing_income_controls = maz_income[maz_income[share_columns].isna().all(axis=1)][["maz_id", "BlockGroup", "HHBASE"]]
if not missing_income_controls.empty:
    county_distribution = income_controls.assign(county_fips=income_controls["BlockGroup"].str[2:5]).groupby("county_fips")[income_columns].sum()
    county_distribution = county_distribution.div(county_distribution.sum(axis=1).replace(0, 1), axis=0)
    regional_distribution = income_controls[income_columns].sum()
    regional_distribution = regional_distribution / regional_distribution.sum()
    county_distribution = county_distribution.rename(columns={column: f"{column}_COUNTY_SHARE" for column in income_columns}).reset_index()
    maz_income = maz_income.merge(county_distribution, on="county_fips", how="left")
    for column in income_columns:
        maz_income[f"{column}_SHARE"] = maz_income[f"{column}_SHARE"].fillna(maz_income[f"{column}_COUNTY_SHARE"]).fillna(regional_distribution[column])
    print(f"Filled household-income shares for {len(missing_income_controls):,} MAZ record(s) without BG income controls.")

for share_column in share_columns:
    maz_income[share_column] = maz_income[share_column].fillna(1 / len(share_columns))

output_income_columns = income_columns.copy()
maz_income[output_income_columns] = maz_income.apply(
    allocate_income_mix,
    axis=1,
    share_columns=share_columns,
    output_columns=output_income_columns,
)
maz_income["HHINC_ALLOCATED_TOTAL"] = maz_income[output_income_columns].sum(axis=1).astype(int)
if not maz_income["HHINC_ALLOCATED_TOTAL"].eq(maz_income["HHBASE"]).all():
    bad_rows = maz_income[~maz_income["HHINC_ALLOCATED_TOTAL"].eq(maz_income["HHBASE"])][["maz_id", "HHBASE", "HHINC_ALLOCATED_TOTAL"]]
    raise ValueError(f"Household-income allocation does not sum to HHBASE: {bad_rows.head().to_dict('records')}")

bg_income_output = (
    maz_income.groupby(["BlockGroup", "county_fips", "county_name"], as_index=False)[output_income_columns]
    .sum()
    .sort_values("BlockGroup")
)
bg_income_output["hhs"] = bg_income_output[output_income_columns].sum(axis=1).astype(int)
output_columns = ["BlockGroup", "hhs", *output_income_columns]
for column in ["hhs", *output_income_columns]:
    bg_income_output[column] = bg_income_output[column].astype(int)

income_validation = bg_income_output.merge(
    income_controls[["BlockGroup", "ACS_HHINC_TOTAL", *income_columns]],
    on="BlockGroup",
    how="left",
    suffixes=("", "_ACS"),
)
income_validation["HHS_MINUS_HHINC"] = income_validation["hhs"] - income_validation[output_income_columns].sum(axis=1)
income_validation["HHS_MINUS_ACS_HHBASE"] = income_validation["hhs"] - income_validation["ACS_HHINC_TOTAL"].fillna(0)

bg_income_output[output_columns].to_csv(income_regional_output_path, index=False)
income_county_paths = []
for (county_fips, county_name), county_rows in bg_income_output.groupby(["county_fips", "county_name"], sort=True):
    county_path = OUTPUT_DIR / income_county_filename_template.format(county_name=county_name)
    county_rows[output_columns].to_csv(county_path, index=False)
    income_county_paths.append(county_path)
income_validation.to_csv(income_validation_path, index=False)

print(f"Saved regional BG household-income controls: {income_regional_output_path}")
print("Saved county BG household-income controls:")
for county_path in income_county_paths:
    print(f"  {county_path}")
print(f"Saved household-income validation: {income_validation_path}")
print(f"Regional households: {bg_income_output['hhs'].sum():,}")

def normalize_tract(series: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    return series.astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(11)

def normalize_blockgroup(series: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    return series.astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(12)

def fill_missing_tract_hhwrk_controls(df: pd.DataFrame, worker_cols: list, tract_col="TRACT") -> pd.DataFrame:
    df_clean = df.copy()
    df_clean[tract_col] = normalize_tract(df_clean[tract_col])
    df_clean[worker_cols] = df_clean[worker_cols].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0).clip(lower=0)
    df_clean["county_fips"] = df_clean[tract_col].str[2:5]
    df_clean["HHWRK_TOTAL"] = df_clean[worker_cols].sum(axis=1)

    empty_mask = df_clean["HHWRK_TOTAL"].eq(0)
    if not empty_mask.any():
        return df_clean.drop(columns=["HHWRK_TOTAL"])

    print(f"Found {int(empty_mask.sum()):,} tract(s) with 0 household-worker controls. Filling from county/regional distributions.")
    county_totals = df_clean.groupby("county_fips")[worker_cols].sum()
    regional_totals = df_clean[worker_cols].sum()

    for index, row in df_clean[empty_mask].iterrows():
        county_fips = row["county_fips"]
        if county_fips in county_totals.index and county_totals.loc[county_fips].sum() > 0:
            df_clean.loc[index, worker_cols] = county_totals.loc[county_fips].values
        elif regional_totals.sum() > 0:
            df_clean.loc[index, worker_cols] = regional_totals.values
        else:
            df_clean.loc[index, worker_cols] = np.ones(len(worker_cols))

    return df_clean.drop(columns=["HHWRK_TOTAL"])

def allocate_worker_mix(row, share_columns, output_columns, total_column="HHBASE"):
    total = int(row[total_column])
    if total <= 0:
        return pd.Series({column: 0 for column in output_columns})

    shares = row[share_columns].astype(float).clip(lower=0)
    if shares.sum() <= 0:
        shares = pd.Series(1 / len(share_columns), index=share_columns)
    else:
        shares = shares / shares.sum()

    exact_values = total * shares
    integer_values = np.floor(exact_values).astype(int)
    diff = total - int(integer_values.sum())
    if diff > 0:
        remainders = exact_values - integer_values
        integer_values.loc[remainders.sort_values(ascending=False).head(diff).index] += 1
    elif diff < 0:
        subtract_index = integer_values[integer_values.gt(0)].sort_values(ascending=False).head(abs(diff)).index
        integer_values.loc[subtract_index] -= 1

    integer_values.index = output_columns
    return integer_values.astype(int)

worker_controls.columns = [column.strip() for column in worker_controls.columns]

worker_controls["ACS_HHWRK_TOTAL"] = worker_controls[worker_columns].sum(axis=1)
for column in worker_columns:

    maz_workers.groupby(["TRACT", "county_fips", "county_name"], as_index=False)["HHBASE"]
    .sum()
    .sort_values("TRACT")

share_columns = [f"{column}_SHARE" for column in worker_columns]
tract_workers = tract_hhbase.merge(worker_controls[["TRACT", "ACS_HHWRK_TOTAL", *share_columns]], on="TRACT", how="left")

missing_worker_controls = tract_workers[tract_workers[share_columns].isna().all(axis=1)][["TRACT", "HHBASE"]]
if not missing_worker_controls.empty:
    county_distribution = worker_controls.assign(county_fips=worker_controls["TRACT"].str[2:5]).groupby("county_fips")[worker_columns].sum()
    county_distribution = county_distribution.div(county_distribution.sum(axis=1).replace(0, 1), axis=0)
    regional_distribution = worker_controls[worker_columns].sum()
    regional_distribution = regional_distribution / regional_distribution.sum()
    county_distribution = county_distribution.rename(columns={column: f"{column}_COUNTY_SHARE" for column in worker_columns}).reset_index()
    tract_workers = tract_workers.merge(county_distribution, on="county_fips", how="left")
    for column in worker_columns:
        tract_workers[f"{column}_SHARE"] = tract_workers[f"{column}_SHARE"].fillna(tract_workers[f"{column}_COUNTY_SHARE"]).fillna(regional_distribution[column])
    print(f"Filled household-worker shares for {len(missing_worker_controls):,} tract record(s) without tract worker controls.")

for share_column in share_columns:
    tract_workers[share_column] = tract_workers[share_column].fillna(1 / len(share_columns))

tract_workers[worker_output_columns] = tract_workers.apply(
    allocate_worker_mix,
    axis=1,
    share_columns=share_columns,

)
tract_workers["hhs"] = tract_workers[worker_output_columns].sum(axis=1).astype(int)
if not tract_workers["hhs"].eq(tract_workers["HHBASE"]).all():
    bad_rows = tract_workers[~tract_workers["hhs"].eq(tract_workers["HHBASE"])][["TRACT", "HHBASE", "hhs"]]
    raise ValueError(f"Household-worker allocation does not sum to HHBASE: {bad_rows.head().to_dict('records')}")

worker_validation["HHS_MINUS_HHWRK"] = worker_validation["hhs"] - worker_validation[worker_output_columns].sum(axis=1)
worker_validation["HHS_MINUS_ACS_HHBASE"] = worker_validation["hhs"] - worker_validation["ACS_HHWRK_TOTAL"].fillna(0)

for (county_fips, county_name), county_rows in tract_workers.groupby(["county_fips", "county_name"], sort=True):

def normalize_blockgroup(series: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    return series.astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(12)

def allocate_binary_by_shares(row, yes_share_col="FAMILY_SHARE", total_col="HHBASE"):
    total = int(row[total_col])
    if total <= 0:
        return pd.Series({"familyhhs": 0, "nonfamilyhhs": 0})

    yes_share = row[yes_share_col]
    if pd.isna(yes_share):
        yes_share = 0.0
    yes_share = min(max(float(yes_share), 0.0), 1.0)
    yes = int(np.floor(total * yes_share))
    remainder = total * yes_share - yes
    if remainder >= 0.5:
        yes += 1
    yes = min(max(yes, 0), total)
    return pd.Series({"familyhhs": yes, "nonfamilyhhs": total - yes})

hht_controls = pd.read_csv(household_type_path, dtype={"BlockGroup": "string"})

required_control_columns = {"BlockGroup", "HHTYPE_FAMILY", "HHTYPE_NONFAMILY"}

for column in ["HHTYPE_FAMILY", "HHTYPE_NONFAMILY"]:

hht_controls["ACS_HHT_TOTAL"] = hht_controls[["HHTYPE_FAMILY", "HHTYPE_NONFAMILY"]].sum(axis=1)
hht_controls["FAMILY_SHARE"] = np.where(
    hht_controls["ACS_HHT_TOTAL"].gt(0),
    hht_controls["HHTYPE_FAMILY"] / hht_controls["ACS_HHT_TOTAL"],
    np.nan,
)

        ["maz_id", "BlockGroup", "county_fips", "county_name", "HHBASE"]
    ].copy()

maz_hht["BlockGroup"] = normalize_blockgroup(maz_hht["BlockGroup"])
maz_hht["county_fips"] = maz_hht["county_fips"].astype(str).str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(3)
maz_hht["HHBASE"] = pd.to_numeric(maz_hht["HHBASE"], errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)
maz_hht = maz_hht.merge(hht_controls[["BlockGroup", "FAMILY_SHARE"]], on="BlockGroup", how="left")

missing_hht_controls = maz_hht[maz_hht["FAMILY_SHARE"].isna()][["maz_id", "BlockGroup", "HHBASE"]]
if not missing_hht_controls.empty:
    county_share = (
        hht_controls.assign(county_fips=hht_controls["BlockGroup"].str[2:5])
        .groupby("county_fips", as_index=False)[["HHTYPE_FAMILY", "ACS_HHT_TOTAL"]]
        .sum()
    )
    county_share["COUNTY_FAMILY_SHARE"] = np.where(
        county_share["ACS_HHT_TOTAL"].gt(0),
        county_share["HHTYPE_FAMILY"] / county_share["ACS_HHT_TOTAL"],
        np.nan,
    )
    regional_share = hht_controls["HHTYPE_FAMILY"].sum() / hht_controls["ACS_HHT_TOTAL"].sum()
    maz_hht = maz_hht.merge(county_share[["county_fips", "COUNTY_FAMILY_SHARE"]], on="county_fips", how="left")
    maz_hht["FAMILY_SHARE"] = maz_hht["FAMILY_SHARE"].fillna(maz_hht["COUNTY_FAMILY_SHARE"]).fillna(regional_share)
    print(f"Filled household-type shares for {len(missing_hht_controls):,} MAZ record(s) without BG household-type controls.")

maz_hht[["familyhhs", "nonfamilyhhs"]] = maz_hht.apply(allocate_binary_by_shares, axis=1)
maz_hht["HHT_TOTAL"] = maz_hht["familyhhs"] + maz_hht["nonfamilyhhs"]
if not maz_hht["HHT_TOTAL"].eq(maz_hht["HHBASE"]).all():
    bad_rows = maz_hht[~maz_hht["HHT_TOTAL"].eq(maz_hht["HHBASE"])][["maz_id", "HHBASE", "HHT_TOTAL"]]
    raise ValueError(f"Household-type allocation does not sum to HHBASE: {bad_rows.head().to_dict('records')}")

bg_hht_output = (
    maz_hht.groupby(["BlockGroup", "county_fips", "county_name"], as_index=False)[["familyhhs", "nonfamilyhhs"]]

file_date = RUN_DATE

age_regional_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"bgpersons_Regional_AGE_distributed_{file_date}.csv"
age_county_filename_template = "bgpersons_{county_name}_AGE_distributed_" + f"{file_date}.csv"

acs_age_columns = ["AGE0004", "AGE0517", "AGE1819", "AGE2024", "AGE2534", "AGE3554", "AGE5564", "AGE65P"]
age_output_columns = ["AGE_0_4", "AGE_5_17", "AGE_18_19", "AGE_20_24", "AGE_25_34", "AGE_35_54", "AGE_55_64", "AGE_65P"]

required_paths = [age_control_path, audit_output_path]
missing_paths = [path for path in required_paths if not Path(path).exists()]
if missing_paths:
    raise FileNotFoundError("Run cells 1.0 and 13.0 first. Missing:\n" + "\n".join(map(str, missing_paths)))

def normalize_blockgroup(series: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    return series.astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(12)

def allocate_age_mix(row, share_columns, output_columns, total_column="POPBASE"):
    total = int(row[total_column])
    if total <= 0:
        return pd.Series({column: 0 for column in output_columns})

    shares = row[share_columns].astype(float).clip(lower=0)
    if shares.sum() <= 0:
        shares = pd.Series(1 / len(share_columns), index=share_columns)
    else:
        shares = shares / shares.sum()

    exact_values = total * shares
    integer_values = np.floor(exact_values).astype(int)
    diff = total - int(integer_values.sum())
    if diff > 0:
        remainders = exact_values - integer_values
        integer_values.loc[remainders.sort_values(ascending=False).head(diff).index] += 1
    elif diff < 0:
        subtract_index = integer_values[integer_values.gt(0)].sort_values(ascending=False).head(abs(diff)).index
        integer_values.loc[subtract_index] -= 1

    integer_values.index = output_columns
    return integer_values.astype(int)

age_controls = pd.read_csv(age_control_path, dtype={"BlockGroup": "string"})
age_controls.columns = [column.strip() for column in age_controls.columns]
missing_age_columns = sorted(set(["BlockGroup", *acs_age_columns]) - set(age_controls.columns))
if missing_age_columns:
    raise KeyError(f"Age controls are missing required column(s): {missing_age_columns}")

age_controls["BlockGroup"] = normalize_blockgroup(age_controls["BlockGroup"])
age_controls[acs_age_columns] = age_controls[acs_age_columns].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0).clip(lower=0)
age_controls["AGE_0_4"] = age_controls["AGE0004"]
age_controls["AGE_5_17"] = age_controls["AGE0517"]
age_controls["AGE_18_19"] = age_controls["AGE1819"]
age_controls["AGE_20_24"] = age_controls["AGE2024"]
age_controls["AGE_25_34"] = age_controls["AGE2534"]
age_controls["AGE_35_54"] = age_controls["AGE3554"]
age_controls["AGE_55_64"] = age_controls["AGE5564"]
age_controls["AGE_65P"] = age_controls["AGE65P"]
age_controls["ACS_AGE_TOTAL"] = age_controls[age_output_columns].sum(axis=1)
for column in age_output_columns:
    age_controls[f"{column}_SHARE"] = np.where(
        age_controls["ACS_AGE_TOTAL"].gt(0),
        age_controls[column] / age_controls["ACS_AGE_TOTAL"],
        np.nan,
    )

if "maz" in globals() and {"maz_id", "BlockGroup", "county_fips", "county_name", "PERSONS"}.issubset(set(maz.columns)):
    maz_age = maz[["maz_id", "BlockGroup", "county_fips", "county_name", "PERSONS"]].copy()
else:
    maz_age = pd.read_csv(audit_output_path, dtype={"maz_id": "Int64", "BlockGroup": "string", "county_fips": "string"})[
        ["maz_id", "BlockGroup", "county_fips", "county_name", "PERSONS"]
    ].copy()

maz_age["BlockGroup"] = normalize_blockgroup(maz_age["BlockGroup"])
maz_age["county_fips"] = maz_age["county_fips"].astype(str).str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(3)
maz_age["PERSONS"] = pd.to_numeric(maz_age["PERSONS"], errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)

bg_persons = (
    maz_age.groupby(["BlockGroup", "county_fips", "county_name"], as_index=False)["PERSONS"]
    .sum()
    .rename(columns={"PERSONS": "POPBASE"})
    .sort_values("BlockGroup")
)
share_columns = [f"{column}_SHARE" for column in age_output_columns]
bg_age = bg_persons.merge(age_controls[["BlockGroup", "ACS_AGE_TOTAL", *share_columns]], on="BlockGroup", how="left")

missing_age_controls = bg_age[bg_age[share_columns].isna().all(axis=1)][["BlockGroup", "POPBASE"]]
if not missing_age_controls.empty:
    county_distribution = age_controls.assign(county_fips=age_controls["BlockGroup"].str[2:5]).groupby("county_fips")[age_output_columns].sum()
    county_distribution = county_distribution.div(county_distribution.sum(axis=1).replace(0, 1), axis=0)
    regional_distribution = age_controls[age_output_columns].sum()
    regional_distribution = regional_distribution / regional_distribution.sum()
    county_distribution = county_distribution.rename(columns={column: f"{column}_COUNTY_SHARE" for column in age_output_columns}).reset_index()
    bg_age = bg_age.merge(county_distribution, on="county_fips", how="left")
    for column in age_output_columns:
        bg_age[f"{column}_SHARE"] = bg_age[f"{column}_SHARE"].fillna(bg_age[f"{column}_COUNTY_SHARE"]).fillna(regional_distribution[column])
    print(f"Filled age shares for {len(missing_age_controls):,} BG record(s) without BG age controls.")

for share_column in share_columns:
    bg_age[share_column] = bg_age[share_column].fillna(1 / len(share_columns))

bg_age[age_output_columns] = bg_age.apply(
    allocate_age_mix,
    axis=1,
    share_columns=share_columns,
    output_columns=age_output_columns,
)
bg_age["persons_final"] = bg_age[age_output_columns].sum(axis=1).astype(int)
if not bg_age["persons_final"].eq(bg_age["POPBASE"]).all():
    bad_rows = bg_age[~bg_age["persons_final"].eq(bg_age["POPBASE"])][["BlockGroup", "POPBASE", "persons_final"]]
    raise ValueError(f"Age allocation does not sum to POPBASE: {bad_rows.head().to_dict('records')}")

output_columns = ["BlockGroup", "persons_final", *age_output_columns]
age_validation = bg_age.merge(
    age_controls[["BlockGroup", "ACS_AGE_TOTAL", *age_output_columns]],
    on="BlockGroup",
    how="left",
    suffixes=("", "_ACS"),
)
age_validation["PERSONS_MINUS_AGE"] = age_validation["persons_final"] - age_validation[age_output_columns].sum(axis=1)
age_validation["PERSONS_MINUS_ACS_POPBASE"] = age_validation["persons_final"] - age_validation["ACS_AGE_TOTAL"].fillna(0)

bg_age[output_columns].to_csv(age_regional_output_path, index=False)
age_county_paths = []
for (county_fips, county_name), county_rows in bg_age.groupby(["county_fips", "county_name"], sort=True):
    county_path = OUTPUT_DIR / age_county_filename_template.format(county_name=county_name)
    county_rows[output_columns].to_csv(county_path, index=False)
    age_county_paths.append(county_path)
age_validation.to_csv(age_validation_path, index=False)

print(f"Saved regional BG age controls: {age_regional_output_path}")
print("Saved county BG age controls:")
for county_path in age_county_paths:
    print(f"  {county_path}")
print(f"Saved BG age validation: {age_validation_path}")
print(f"Regional persons: {bg_age['persons_final'].sum():,}")

bg_age[output_columns].head()
