# Reader note: this cell implements the section described above and writes only the configured intermediate/final outputs.


file_date = RUN_DATE
acs_year = YEAR

occupation_control_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_OccupationControlsTract_{file_date}.csv"
age_control_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"ACS5year{acs_year}_AgeControlsBG_{file_date}.csv"
audit_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"MAZ_Person_Controls_audit_{file_date}.csv"
occupation_regional_output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"Tractpersons_Regional_OCCU_distributed_{file_date}.csv"
occupation_county_filename_template = "Tractpersons_{county_name}_OCCU_distributed_" + f"{file_date}.csv"
occupation_validation_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"Tract_OCCU_distribution_validation_{file_date}.csv"

occupation_worker_columns = ["OCC_1_MGMT", "OCC_2_SVC", "OCC_3_SALES", "OCC_4_NAT", "OCC_5_PROD", "OCC_6_MIL"]
occupation_output_columns = ["OCC_0", *occupation_worker_columns]
age_columns = ["AGE0004", "AGE0517", "AGE1819", "AGE2024", "AGE2534", "AGE3554", "AGE5564", "AGE65P"]

required_paths = [occupation_control_path, age_control_path, audit_output_path]
missing_paths = [path for path in required_paths if not Path(path).exists()]
if missing_paths:
    raise FileNotFoundError("Run cells 1.0, 3.0, and 13.0 first. Missing:\n" + "\n".join(map(str, missing_paths)))

def normalize_tract(series: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    return series.astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(11)

def normalize_blockgroup(series: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    return series.astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(12)

def fill_missing_tract_occupation_controls(df: pd.DataFrame, occ_cols: list, tract_col="TRACT") -> pd.DataFrame:
    df_clean = df.copy()
    df_clean[tract_col] = normalize_tract(df_clean[tract_col])
    df_clean[occ_cols] = df_clean[occ_cols].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0).clip(lower=0)
    df_clean["county_fips"] = df_clean[tract_col].str[2:5]
    df_clean["OCC_TOTAL"] = df_clean[occ_cols].sum(axis=1)

    empty_mask = df_clean["OCC_TOTAL"].eq(0)
    if not empty_mask.any():
        return df_clean.drop(columns=["OCC_TOTAL"])

    print(f"Found {int(empty_mask.sum()):,} tract(s) with 0 occupation controls. Filling from county/regional distributions.")
    county_totals = df_clean.groupby("county_fips")[occ_cols].sum()
    regional_totals = df_clean[occ_cols].sum()
    for index, row in df_clean[empty_mask].iterrows():
        county_fips = row["county_fips"]
        if county_fips in county_totals.index and county_totals.loc[county_fips].sum() > 0:
            df_clean.loc[index, occ_cols] = county_totals.loc[county_fips].values
        elif regional_totals.sum() > 0:
            df_clean.loc[index, occ_cols] = regional_totals.values
        else:
            df_clean.loc[index, occ_cols] = np.ones(len(occ_cols))

    return df_clean.drop(columns=["OCC_TOTAL"])

def allocate_occupation_mix(row, share_columns, output_columns, total_column="POPBASE"):
    total = int(row[total_column])
    if total <= 0:
        return pd.Series({column: 0 for column in output_columns})

    shares = row[share_columns].astype(float).clip(lower=0)
    if shares.sum() <= 0:
        shares = pd.Series(1 / len(share_columns), index=share_columns)
    else:
        shares = shares / shares.sum()

    exact_values = total * shares
    integer_values = np.floor(exact_values).astype(int)
    diff = total - int(integer_values.sum())
    if diff > 0:
        remainders = exact_values - integer_values
        integer_values.loc[remainders.sort_values(ascending=False).head(diff).index] += 1
    elif diff < 0:
        subtract_index = integer_values[integer_values.gt(0)].sort_values(ascending=False).head(abs(diff)).index
        integer_values.loc[subtract_index] -= 1

    integer_values.index = output_columns
    return integer_values.astype(int)

occupation_controls = pd.read_csv(occupation_control_path, dtype={"TRACT": "string"})
occupation_controls.columns = [column.strip() for column in occupation_controls.columns]
missing_occupation_columns = sorted(set(["TRACT", *occupation_worker_columns]) - set(occupation_controls.columns))
if missing_occupation_columns:
    raise KeyError(f"Occupation controls are missing required column(s): {missing_occupation_columns}")
occupation_controls["TRACT"] = normalize_tract(occupation_controls["TRACT"])
occupation_controls = fill_missing_tract_occupation_controls(occupation_controls, occupation_worker_columns, tract_col="TRACT")

age_controls = pd.read_csv(age_control_path, dtype={"BlockGroup": "string"})
age_controls.columns = [column.strip() for column in age_controls.columns]
age_controls["BlockGroup"] = normalize_blockgroup(age_controls["BlockGroup"])
age_controls["TRACT"] = age_controls["BlockGroup"].str[:11]
age_controls[age_columns] = age_controls[age_columns].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0).clip(lower=0)
tract_acs_pop = age_controls.groupby("TRACT", as_index=False)[age_columns].sum()
tract_acs_pop["ACS_POPBASE"] = tract_acs_pop[age_columns].sum(axis=1)

occupation_controls = occupation_controls.merge(tract_acs_pop[["TRACT", "ACS_POPBASE"]], on="TRACT", how="left")
occupation_controls["OCC_WORKERS_TOTAL"] = occupation_controls[occupation_worker_columns].sum(axis=1)
occupation_controls["OCC_0"] = (occupation_controls["ACS_POPBASE"].fillna(0) - occupation_controls["OCC_WORKERS_TOTAL"]).clip(lower=0)
occupation_controls["OCC_CONTROL_TOTAL"] = occupation_controls[occupation_output_columns].sum(axis=1)
for column in occupation_output_columns:
    occupation_controls[f"{column}_SHARE"] = np.where(
        occupation_controls["OCC_CONTROL_TOTAL"].gt(0),
        occupation_controls[column] / occupation_controls["OCC_CONTROL_TOTAL"],
        np.nan,
    )

if "maz" in globals() and {"maz_id", "BlockGroup", "county_fips", "county_name", "PERSONS"}.issubset(set(maz.columns)):
    maz_occupation = maz[["maz_id", "BlockGroup", "county_fips", "county_name", "PERSONS"]].copy()
else:
    maz_occupation = pd.read_csv(audit_output_path, dtype={"maz_id": "Int64", "BlockGroup": "string", "county_fips": "string"})[
        ["maz_id", "BlockGroup", "county_fips", "county_name", "PERSONS"]
    ].copy()

maz_occupation["BlockGroup"] = normalize_blockgroup(maz_occupation["BlockGroup"])
maz_occupation["TRACT"] = maz_occupation["BlockGroup"].str[:11]
maz_occupation["county_fips"] = maz_occupation["county_fips"].astype(str).str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(3)
maz_occupation["PERSONS"] = pd.to_numeric(maz_occupation["PERSONS"], errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)

tract_persons = (
    maz_occupation.groupby(["TRACT", "county_fips", "county_name"], as_index=False)["PERSONS"]
    .sum()
    .rename(columns={"PERSONS": "POPBASE"})
    .sort_values("TRACT")
)
share_columns = [f"{column}_SHARE" for column in occupation_output_columns]
tract_occupation = tract_persons.merge(occupation_controls[["TRACT", "OCC_CONTROL_TOTAL", *share_columns]], on="TRACT", how="left")

missing_occupation_controls = tract_occupation[tract_occupation[share_columns].isna().all(axis=1)][["TRACT", "POPBASE"]]
if not missing_occupation_controls.empty:
    county_distribution = occupation_controls.assign(county_fips=occupation_controls["TRACT"].str[2:5]).groupby("county_fips")[occupation_output_columns].sum()
    county_distribution = county_distribution.div(county_distribution.sum(axis=1).replace(0, 1), axis=0)
    regional_distribution = occupation_controls[occupation_output_columns].sum()
    regional_distribution = regional_distribution / regional_distribution.sum()
    county_distribution = county_distribution.rename(columns={column: f"{column}_COUNTY_SHARE" for column in occupation_output_columns}).reset_index()
    tract_occupation = tract_occupation.merge(county_distribution, on="county_fips", how="left")
    for column in occupation_output_columns:
        tract_occupation[f"{column}_SHARE"] = tract_occupation[f"{column}_SHARE"].fillna(tract_occupation[f"{column}_COUNTY_SHARE"]).fillna(regional_distribution[column])
    print(f"Filled occupation shares for {len(missing_occupation_controls):,} tract record(s) without tract occupation controls.")

for share_column in share_columns:
    tract_occupation[share_column] = tract_occupation[share_column].fillna(1 / len(share_columns))

tract_occupation[occupation_output_columns] = tract_occupation.apply(
    allocate_occupation_mix,
    axis=1,
    share_columns=share_columns,
    output_columns=occupation_output_columns,
)
tract_occupation["persons_final"] = tract_occupation[occupation_output_columns].sum(axis=1).astype(int)
if not tract_occupation["persons_final"].eq(tract_occupation["POPBASE"]).all():
    bad_rows = tract_occupation[~tract_occupation["persons_final"].eq(tract_occupation["POPBASE"])][["TRACT", "POPBASE", "persons_final"]]
    raise ValueError(f"Occupation allocation does not sum to POPBASE: {bad_rows.head().to_dict('records')}")

output_columns = ["TRACT", "persons_final", *occupation_output_columns]
occupation_validation = tract_occupation.merge(
    occupation_controls[["TRACT", "ACS_POPBASE", "OCC_WORKERS_TOTAL", "OCC_CONTROL_TOTAL", *occupation_output_columns]],
    on="TRACT",
    how="left",
    suffixes=("", "_ACS"),
)
occupation_validation["PERSONS_MINUS_OCCUPATION"] = occupation_validation["persons_final"] - occupation_validation[occupation_output_columns].sum(axis=1)
occupation_validation["PERSONS_MINUS_ACS_POPBASE"] = occupation_validation["persons_final"] - occupation_validation["ACS_POPBASE"].fillna(0)

tract_occupation[output_columns].to_csv(occupation_regional_output_path, index=False)
occupation_county_paths = []
for (county_fips, county_name), county_rows in tract_occupation.groupby(["county_fips", "county_name"], sort=True):
    county_path = OUTPUT_DIR / occupation_county_filename_template.format(county_name=county_name)
    county_rows[output_columns].to_csv(county_path, index=False)
    occupation_county_paths.append(county_path)
occupation_validation.to_csv(occupation_validation_path, index=False)

print(f"Saved regional tract occupation controls: {occupation_regional_output_path}")
print("Saved county tract occupation controls:")
for county_path in occupation_county_paths:
    print(f"  {county_path}")
print(f"Saved tract occupation validation: {occupation_validation_path}")
print(f"Regional persons: {tract_occupation['persons_final'].sum():,}")

if missing_paths:
    raise FileNotFoundError("Run cells 2.0 and 13.0 first. Missing:\n" + "\n".join(map(str, missing_paths)))

def normalize_blockgroup(series: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    return series.astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(12)

def allocate_sex_mix(row, share_columns, output_columns, total_column="POPBASE"):
    total = int(row[total_column])
    if total <= 0:
        return pd.Series({column: 0 for column in output_columns})

    shares = row[share_columns].astype(float).clip(lower=0)
    if shares.sum() <= 0:
        shares = pd.Series(1 / len(share_columns), index=share_columns)
    else:
        shares = shares / shares.sum()

    exact_values = total * shares
    integer_values = np.floor(exact_values).astype(int)
    diff = total - int(integer_values.sum())
    if diff > 0:
        remainders = exact_values - integer_values
        integer_values.loc[remainders.sort_values(ascending=False).head(diff).index] += 1
    elif diff < 0:
        subtract_index = integer_values[integer_values.gt(0)].sort_values(ascending=False).head(abs(diff)).index
        integer_values.loc[subtract_index] -= 1

    integer_values.index = output_columns
    return integer_values.astype(int)

def fill_missing_bg_sex_controls(bg_sex: pd.DataFrame, sex_controls: pd.DataFrame, share_columns: list) -> pd.DataFrame:
    bg_sex = bg_sex.copy()
    missing_sex_controls = bg_sex[bg_sex[share_columns].isna().all(axis=1)][["BlockGroup", "POPBASE"]]
    if missing_sex_controls.empty:
        return bg_sex

    county_distribution = sex_controls.assign(county_fips=sex_controls["BlockGroup"].str[2:5]).groupby("county_fips")[sex_output_columns].sum()
    county_distribution = county_distribution.div(county_distribution.sum(axis=1).replace(0, 1), axis=0)
    regional_distribution = sex_controls[sex_output_columns].sum()
    regional_distribution = regional_distribution / regional_distribution.sum()

    county_distribution = county_distribution.rename(columns={column: f"{column}_COUNTY_SHARE" for column in sex_output_columns}).reset_index()
    bg_sex = bg_sex.merge(county_distribution, on="county_fips", how="left")
    for column in sex_output_columns:
        bg_sex[f"{column}_SHARE"] = bg_sex[f"{column}_SHARE"].fillna(bg_sex[f"{column}_COUNTY_SHARE"]).fillna(regional_distribution[column])

    print(f"Filled sex shares for {len(missing_sex_controls):,} BG record(s) without BG sex controls.")
    return bg_sex

sex_controls["BlockGroup"] = normalize_blockgroup(sex_controls["BlockGroup"])

sex_controls["ACS_SEX_TOTAL"] = sex_controls[sex_output_columns].sum(axis=1)
for column in sex_output_columns:

    ].copy()

maz_sex["BlockGroup"] = normalize_blockgroup(maz_sex["BlockGroup"])
maz_sex["county_fips"] = maz_sex["county_fips"].astype(str).str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(3)
maz_sex["PERSONS"] = pd.to_numeric(maz_sex["PERSONS"], errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)

bg_persons = (
    maz_sex.groupby(["BlockGroup", "county_fips", "county_name"], as_index=False)["PERSONS"]
    .sum()
    .rename(columns={"PERSONS": "POPBASE"})
    .sort_values("BlockGroup")
)
share_columns = [f"{column}_SHARE" for column in sex_output_columns]
bg_sex = bg_persons.merge(sex_controls[["BlockGroup", "ACS_SEX_TOTAL", *share_columns]], on="BlockGroup", how="left")
bg_sex = fill_missing_bg_sex_controls(bg_sex, sex_controls, share_columns)

for share_column in share_columns:
    bg_sex[share_column] = bg_sex[share_column].fillna(1 / len(share_columns))

bg_sex[sex_output_columns] = bg_sex.apply(
    allocate_sex_mix,
    axis=1,
    share_columns=share_columns,
    output_columns=sex_output_columns,

bg_sex["persons_final"] = bg_sex[sex_output_columns].sum(axis=1).astype(int)
if not bg_sex["persons_final"].eq(bg_sex["POPBASE"]).all():
    bad_rows = bg_sex[~bg_sex["persons_final"].eq(bg_sex["POPBASE"])][["BlockGroup", "POPBASE", "persons_final"]]

def read_control(path: str, key_column: str, id_kind: str, columns: list = None) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = pd.read_csv(path, dtype={key_column: "string"})
    df.columns = [column.strip() for column in df.columns]
    if key_column not in df.columns:
        raise KeyError(f"{path} is missing required key column {key_column}.")
    if columns is not None:
        missing_columns = sorted(set([key_column, *columns]) - set(df.columns))
        if missing_columns:
            raise KeyError(f"{path} is missing required column(s): {missing_columns}")
        df = df[[key_column, *columns]].copy()
    if id_kind == "maz":
        df[key_column] = pd.to_numeric(df[key_column], errors="coerce")
        df = df.dropna(subset=[key_column])
        df[key_column] = df[key_column].astype(int)
    elif id_kind == "bg":
        df[key_column] = normalize_blockgroup(df[key_column])
    elif id_kind == "tract":
        df[key_column] = normalize_tract(df[key_column])
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported id_kind: {id_kind}")
    value_columns = [column for column in df.columns if column != key_column]
    df[value_columns] = df[value_columns].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0).round().astype(int)
    return df.groupby(key_column, as_index=False)[value_columns].sum()

def merge_controls(base: pd.DataFrame, add: pd.DataFrame, key_column: str, keep_columns: list) -> pd.DataFrame:
    add_columns = [key_column, *keep_columns]
    missing_columns = sorted(set(add_columns) - set(add.columns))
    if missing_columns:
        raise KeyError(f"Input control is missing merge column(s): {missing_columns}")
    return base.merge(add[add_columns], on=key_column, how="outer")

def fill_control_values(df: pd.DataFrame, key_column: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = df.copy()
    value_columns = [column for column in df.columns if column != key_column]
    df[value_columns] = df[value_columns].fillna(0).round().astype(int)
    return df.sort_values(key_column).reset_index(drop=True)

docs.title: Introduction¶
docs.text: This notebook prepares non-group-quarters PopulationSim control totals. It combines ACS demographic controls, housing-unit information, vacancy assumptions, and geography crosswalks into MAZ, block group, tract, and county files used to synthesize the household population.

docs.title: Contents¶
docs.text:
• Configuration, ACS API setup, and shared helper functions
  • ACS-derived controls for age, sex, occupation, workers, children, household size, income, and household type
  • Housing-unit and vacancy-rate controls at MAZ level
  • Allocation of household and person distributions across model geographies
  • Horizontal control-total exports and PopulationSim validation

docs.title: Workflow¶
docs.text:
1. Load configuration and define reusable Census API, validation, and allocation helpers.
  2. Pull ACS tables and convert published categories into PopulationSim control bins.
  3. Build MAZ household and person totals from housing units, vacancy rates, and county population controls.
  4. Distribute demographic and household attributes across block group or tract geographies.
  5. Assemble horizontal control files for MAZ, block group, and tract levels, then run validation when enabled.

docs.title: Public Use Notes¶
docs.text:
• Use environment variables or an ignored local file for Census API credentials.
  • The validation CSVs are intended to document balancing differences and should be reviewed before publishing model inputs.

# Reader note: this cell implements the section described above and writes only the configured intermediate/final outputs.
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import yaml
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) File Paths
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
CONFIG_PATH = Path("_config.yaml")
CONFIG = yaml.safe_load(CONFIG_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
POSTPROCESS_CONFIG = CONFIG["postprocess"]

postprocess_input_dir = Path(CONFIG["paths"]["postprocess_input_dir"])
output_dir = postprocess_input_dir

student_input_path = postprocess_input_dir / POSTPROCESS_CONFIG["synthetic_students_file"]
person_input_path = postprocess_input_dir / POSTPROCESS_CONFIG["synthetic_non_gq_persons_file"]
hh_input_path = postprocess_input_dir / POSTPROCESS_CONFIG["synthetic_non_gq_households_file"]
output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Target Columns
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
person_source_cols = [
    "maz_id",
    "household_id",
    "per_num",
    "AGEP",
    "SEX",
    "WKHP",
    "WKW",
    "ESR",
    "SCHG",
    "MIL",
    "NAICSP",
    "INDP",
    "OCCP",
    "OCCP_Code",
    "SCHL",
]

hh_source_cols = [
    "maz_id",
    "household_id",
    "PUMA",
    "TYPEHUGQ",
    "NP",
    "HHT",
    "HINCP",
    "Num_Workers",
    "VEH",
    "BLD",
]

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Process Student Files (Persons & Derived Households)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"Loading student input: {student_input_path}")
df_students = pd.read_csv(student_input_path)

# Ensure numeric types for logic operations
df_students["ESR"] = pd.to_numeric(df_students["ESR"], errors="coerce").fillna(0)
if "ADJ_WAGP" in df_students.columns:
    df_students["ADJ_WAGP"] = pd.to_numeric(
        df_students["ADJ_WAGP"], errors="coerce"
    ).fillna(0)
else:
    df_students["ADJ_WAGP"] = 0

# --- File 1: Student Persons ---
avail_person_cols = [col for col in person_source_cols if col in df_students.columns]
df_student_persons = df_students[avail_person_cols].copy()

out_student_persons_path = (
    output_dir / "PersonsStudentsInDorm_Output4ABM.csv"
)
df_student_persons.to_csv(out_student_persons_path, index=False)
print(f"Saved Student Persons ({len(df_student_persons):,} rows): {out_student_persons_path}")

# --- File 2: Student Households ---
df_student_hh = df_students.copy()

# Derived Fields
df_student_hh["Num_Workers"] = df_student_hh["ESR"].apply(
    lambda x: 1 if x in [1, 2, 4, 5] else 0
)
df_student_hh["HINCP"] = df_student_hh["ADJ_WAGP"]

# Group Quarters Default Flags (Type 2 = Non-Institutional GQ / Dorms)
df_student_hh["TYPEHUGQ"] = 3
df_student_hh["NP"] = 1
df_student_hh["HHT"] = 0
df_student_hh["BLD"] = 0
if "PUMA" not in df_student_hh.columns:
    df_student_hh["PUMA"] = -9

# Assign Vehicles (58% -> 0 VEH, 42% -> 1 VEH)
np.random.seed(42)  # For reproducible assignment
df_student_hh["VEH"] = np.random.choice(
    a=[0, 1], size=len(df_student_hh), p=[0.58, 0.42]
)

avail_student_hh_cols = [
    col for col in hh_source_cols if col in df_student_hh.columns
]
df_student_hh_out = df_student_hh[avail_student_hh_cols].copy()

out_student_hh_path = (
    output_dir / "HouseholdsStudentsInDorm_Output4ABM.csv"
)
df_student_hh_out.to_csv(out_student_hh_path, index=False)
print(f"Saved Student Households ({len(df_student_hh_out):,} rows): {out_student_hh_path}")

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Process Non-GQ Files (Persons & Households)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"Loading Non-GQ persons: {person_input_path}")
df_nongq_persons = pd.read_csv(person_input_path)
avail_nongq_person_cols = [
    col for col in person_source_cols if col in df_nongq_persons.columns
]
df_nongq_persons_out = df_nongq_persons[avail_nongq_person_cols].copy()

out_nongq_persons_path = output_dir / "PersonsNonGQ_Output4ABM.csv"
df_nongq_persons_out.to_csv(out_nongq_persons_path, index=False)
print(f"Saved Non-GQ Persons ({len(df_nongq_persons_out):,} rows): {out_nongq_persons_path}")

print(f"Loading Non-GQ households: {hh_input_path}")
df_nongq_hh = pd.read_csv(hh_input_path)
avail_nongq_hh_cols = [
    col for col in hh_source_cols if col in df_nongq_hh.columns
]
df_nongq_hh_out = df_nongq_hh[avail_nongq_hh_cols].copy()

out_nongq_hh_path = output_dir / "HouseholdsNonGQ_Output4ABM.csv"
df_nongq_hh_out.to_csv(out_nongq_hh_path, index=False)
print(f"Saved Non-GQ Households ({len(df_nongq_hh_out):,} rows): {out_nongq_hh_path}")

print("\nSuccessfully produced all 4 CSV files ready for ID renumbering!")

# Reader note: this cell implements the section described above and writes only the configured intermediate/final outputs.
from pathlib import Path
import sys

import pandas as pd
import yaml

# --- Configuration & Paths ---
CONFIG_PATH = Path("_config.yaml")
CONFIG = yaml.safe_load(CONFIG_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
POSTPROCESS_CONFIG = CONFIG["postprocess"]

input_folder = Path(CONFIG["paths"]["postprocess_input_dir"])
output_folder = Path(CONFIG["paths"]["postprocess_output_dir"])


# Inputs
hh_students_path = input_folder / POSTPROCESS_CONFIG["staged_student_households_file"]
hh_regular_path = input_folder / POSTPROCESS_CONFIG["staged_non_gq_households_file"]
per_students_path = input_folder / POSTPROCESS_CONFIG["staged_student_persons_file"]
per_regular_path = input_folder / POSTPROCESS_CONFIG["staged_non_gq_persons_file"]

# Outputs
input_folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output_folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
final_hhs_path = output_folder / POSTPROCESS_CONFIG["final_households_file"]
final_persons_path = output_folder / POSTPROCESS_CONFIG["final_persons_file"]

# Column Mapping Definitions
rename_hh_cols = {
    "maz_id": "maz_id",
    "household_id": "hh_id",
    "PUMA": "pums_id",
    "TYPEHUGQ": "res_type",
    "NP": "hh_size",
    "HHT": "hh_type",
    "HINCP": "hh_income",
    "Num_Workers": "hh_workers",
    "VEH": "hh_vehicles",
    "BLD": "unit_type",
}

rename_per_cols = {
    "household_id": "hh_id",
    "per_num": "person_num",
    "AGEP": "age",
    "SEX": "sex",
    "WKHP": "wrk_hours_wk",
    "WKW": "wrk_weeks_yr",
    "ESR": "emp_status",
    "SCHG": "sch_grade",
    "MIL": "mil_type",
    "NAICSP": "naics_id",
    "INDP": "work_code",
    "OCCP": "occ_code",
    "OCCP_Code": "occ_cat",
    "SCHL": "edu_attain",
}

output_per_columns = [
    "person_id",
    "maz_id",
    "hh_id",
    "person_num",
    "age",
    "sex",
    "wrk_hours_wk",
    "wrk_weeks_yr",
    "emp_status",
    "sch_grade",
    "mil_type",
    "naics_id",
    "work_code",
    "occ_code",
    "occ_cat",
    "edu_attain",
]

output_hh_columns = [
    "maz_id",
    "hh_id",
    "pums_id",
    "res_type",
    "hh_size",
    "hh_type",
    "hh_income",
    "hh_workers",
    "hh_vehicles",
    "unit_type",
]

# =========================================================
# 1. LOAD AND RENAME DATASETS
# =========================================================
print("Loading all household and person segments...")
df_hh_stud = pd.read_csv(hh_students_path).rename(columns=rename_hh_cols)
df_hh_reg = pd.read_csv(hh_regular_path).rename(columns=rename_hh_cols)
df_per_stud = pd.read_csv(per_students_path).rename(columns=rename_per_cols)
df_per_reg = pd.read_csv(per_regular_path).rename(columns=rename_per_cols)

# Filter for relevant output columns
df_hh_stud = df_hh_stud[
    [c for c in output_hh_columns if c in df_hh_stud.columns]
]
df_hh_reg = df_hh_reg[[c for c in output_hh_columns if c in df_hh_reg.columns]]

# =========================================================
# 2. STRICT SCHEMA VERIFICATION (PRE-CHECK)
# =========================================================
print("\nVerifying field schemas match perfectly...")

schema_errors = False

if list(df_hh_stud.columns) != list(df_hh_reg.columns):
    print("\n[!] CRITICAL ERROR: Household schemas do not match!")
    print(f"File 1 columns: {list(df_hh_stud.columns)}")
    print(f"File 2 columns: {list(df_hh_reg.columns)}")
    schema_errors = True
else:
    print("  Success: Household schemas match perfectly.")

if list(df_per_stud.columns) != list(df_per_reg.columns):
    print("\n[!] CRITICAL ERROR: Person schemas do not match!")
    print(f"File 3 columns: {list(df_per_stud.columns)}")
    print(f"File 4 columns: {list(df_per_reg.columns)}")
    schema_errors = True
else:
    print("  Success: Person schemas match perfectly.")

if schema_errors:
    print("\n[!] Process aborted. Please resolve column discrepancies.")
    sys.exit()

# =========================================================
# 3. COMBINE HOUSEHOLDS & RE-INDEX KEYS
# =========================================================
print("\nProcessing Households...")

max_stud_hh_id = df_hh_stud["hh_id"].max()
print(f"  -> Student households end at ID: {max_stud_hh_id}")

# Offset regular household IDs to keep all IDs unique
df_hh_reg["new_hh_id"] = df_hh_reg["hh_id"] + max_stud_hh_id
hh_id_mapping = dict(zip(df_hh_reg["hh_id"], df_hh_reg["new_hh_id"]))

df_hh_reg["hh_id"] = df_hh_reg["new_hh_id"]
df_hh_reg = df_hh_reg.drop(columns=["new_hh_id"])

# Combine Households
df_final_hhs = pd.concat([df_hh_stud, df_hh_reg], ignore_index=True)
df_final_hhs = df_final_hhs.sort_values(by="hh_id").reset_index(drop=True)

# =========================================================
# 4. ALIGN PERSON RECORDS
# =========================================================
print("Processing Persons...")

# Update regular person household IDs using mapped values
df_per_reg["hh_id"] = df_per_reg["hh_id"].map(hh_id_mapping)

# Combine Persons
df_final_persons = pd.concat([df_per_stud, df_per_reg], ignore_index=True)
df_final_persons = df_final_persons.sort_values(
    by=["hh_id", "person_num"]
).reset_index(drop=True)

# Generate unique sequential person IDs
df_final_persons["person_id"] = range(1, len(df_final_persons) + 1)

# Format person table column order
avail_per_cols = [
    c for c in output_per_columns if c in df_final_persons.columns
]
df_final_persons = df_final_persons[avail_per_cols]

# =========================================================
# 5. POST-CHECK VALIDATION
# =========================================================
print("\n[POST-CHECK] Validating person-to-household size integrity...")

person_counts = (
    df_final_persons.groupby("hh_id")
    .size()
    .reset_index(name="actual_person_count")
)
df_validation = pd.merge(
    df_final_hhs[["hh_id", "hh_size"]], person_counts, on="hh_id", how="left"
)
df_validation["actual_person_count"] = (
    df_validation["actual_person_count"].fillna(0).astype(int)
)

mismatches = df_validation[
    df_validation["hh_size"] != df_validation["actual_person_count"]
]

if len(mismatches) == 0:
    print(
        "  Success! Every household 'hh_size' field matches the actual person record count."
    )
else:
    print(
        f"\n[!] WARNING: Found {len(mismatches)} households with mismatched sizes!"
    )
    print(mismatches.head(10))
    print("\nAborting file save to protect data integrity.")
    sys.exit()

# =========================================================
# 6. EXPORT FINALIZED SYNTHETIC DATASETS
# =========================================================
print("\nExporting final combined files...")
df_final_hhs.to_csv(final_hhs_path, index=False)
df_final_persons.to_csv(final_persons_path, index=False)

print("\n--- INTEGRITY CHECKS ---")
print(f"Combined Households Row Count: {len(df_final_hhs):,}")
print(f"Combined Persons Row Count:    {len(df_final_persons):,}")
print(
    f"Households ID Range:           {df_final_hhs['hh_id'].min()} to {df_final_hhs['hh_id'].max()}"
)
print(f"Persons unique household keys: {df_final_persons['hh_id'].nunique():,}")

unmatched_persons = ~df_final_persons["hh_id"].isin(df_final_hhs["hh_id"])
print(f"Unmatched Person Records:      {unmatched_persons.sum()}")
print("\nSuccess! Combined files exported cleanly.")

Inputs hh_students_path = input_folder / POSTPROCESS_CONFIG["staged_student_households_file"] hh_regular_path = input_folder / POSTPROCESS_CONFIG["staged_non_gq_households_file"] per_students_path = input_folder / POSTPROCESS_CONFIG["staged_student_persons_file"] per_regular_path = input_folder / POSTPROCESS_CONFIG["staged_non_gq_persons_file"] # Column Mapping Definitions rename_hh_cols = { "maz_id": "maz_id", "household_id": "hh_id", "PUMA": "pums_id", "TYPEHUGQ": "res_type", "NP": "hh_size", "HHT": "hh_type", "HINCP": "hh_income", "Num_Workers": "hh_workers", "VEH": "hh_vehicles", "BLD": "unit_type", } rename_per_cols = { "household_id": "hh_id", "per_num": "person_num", "AGEP": "age", "SEX": "sex", "WKHP": "wrk_hours_wk", "WKW": "wrk_weeks_yr", "ESR": "emp_status", "SCHG": "sch_grade", "MIL": "mil_type", "NAICSP": "naics_id", "INDP": "work_code", "OCCP": "occ_code", "OCCP_Code": "occ_cat", "SCHL": "edu_attain", } output_per_columns = [ "person_id", "maz_id", "hh_id", "person_num", "age", "sex", "wrk_hours_wk", "wrk_weeks_yr", "emp_status", "sch_grade", "mil_type", "naics_id", "work_code", "occ_code", "occ_cat", "edu_attain", ] output_hh_columns = [ "maz_id", "hh_id", "pums_id", "res_type", "hh_size", "hh_type", "hh_income", "hh_workers", "hh_vehicles", "unit_type", ] # ========================================================= # 1. LOAD AND RENAME DATASETS # ========================================================= print("Loading all household and person segments...") df_hh_stud = pd.read_csv(hh_students_path).rename(columns=rename_hh_cols) df_hh_reg = pd.read_csv(hh_regular_path).rename(columns=rename_hh_cols) df_per_stud = pd.read_csv(per_students_path).rename(columns=rename_per_cols) df_per_reg = pd.read_csv(per_regular_path).rename(columns=rename_per_cols) # Filter for relevant output columns df_hh_stud = df_hh_stud[ [c for c in output_hh_columns if c in df_hh_stud.columns] ] df_hh_reg = df_hh_reg[[c for c in output_hh_columns if c in df_hh_reg.columns]] # ========================================================= # 2. STRICT SCHEMA VERIFICATION (PRE-CHECK) # ========================================================= print("\nVerifying field schemas match perfectly...") schema_errors = False if list(df_hh_stud.columns) != list(df_hh_reg.columns): print("\n[!] CRITICAL ERROR: Household schemas do not match!") print(f"File 1 columns: {list(df_hh_stud.columns)}") print(f"File 2 columns: {list(df_hh_reg.columns)}") schema_errors = True else: print(" Success: Household schemas match perfectly.") if list(df_per_stud.columns) != list(df_per_reg.columns): print("\n[!] CRITICAL ERROR: Person schemas do not match!") print(f"File 3 columns: {list(df_per_stud.columns)}") print(f"File 4 columns: {list(df_per_reg.columns)}") schema_errors = True else: print(" Success: Person schemas match perfectly.") if schema_errors: print("\n[!] Process aborted. Please resolve column discrepancies.") sys.exit() # ========================================================= # 3. COMBINE HOUSEHOLDS & RE-INDEX KEYS # ========================================================= print("\nProcessing Households...") max_stud_hh_id = df_hh_stud["hh_id"].max() print(f" -> Student households end at ID: {max_stud_hh_id}") # Offset regular household IDs to keep all IDs unique df_hh_reg["new_hh_id"] = df_hh_reg["hh_id"] + max_stud_hh_id hh_id_mapping = dict(zip(df_hh_reg["hh_id"], df_hh_reg["new_hh_id"])) df_hh_reg["hh_id"] = df_hh_reg["new_hh_id"] df_hh_reg = df_hh_reg.drop(columns=["new_hh_id"]) # Combine Households df_final_hhs = pd.concat([df_hh_stud, df_hh_reg], ignore_index=True) df_final_hhs = df_final_hhs.sort_values(by="hh_id").reset_index(drop=True) # ========================================================= # 4. ALIGN PERSON RECORDS # ========================================================= print("Processing Persons...") # Update regular person household IDs using mapped values df_per_reg["hh_id"] = df_per_reg["hh_id"].map(hh_id_mapping) # Combine Persons df_final_persons = pd.concat([df_per_stud, df_per_reg], ignore_index=True) df_final_persons = df_final_persons.sort_values( by=["hh_id", "person_num"] ).reset_index(drop=True) # Generate unique sequential person IDs df_final_persons["person_id"] = range(1, len(df_final_persons) + 1) # Format person table column order avail_per_cols = [ c for c in output_per_columns if c in df_final_persons.columns ] df_final_persons = df_final_persons[avail_per_cols] # ========================================================= # 5. POST-CHECK VALIDATION # ========================================================= print("\n[POST-CHECK] Validating person-to-household size integrity...") person_counts = ( df_final_persons.groupby("hh_id") .size() .reset_index(name="actual_person_count") ) df_validation = pd.merge( df_final_hhs[["hh_id", "hh_size"]], person_counts, on="hh_id", how="left" ) df_validation["actual_person_count"] = ( df_validation["actual_person_count"].fillna(0).astype(int) ) mismatches = df_validation[ df_validation["hh_size"] != df_validation["actual_person_count"] ] if len(mismatches) == 0: print( " Success! Every household 'hh_size' field matches the actual person record count." ) else: print( f"\n[!] WARNING: Found {len(mismatches)} households with mismatched sizes!" ) print(mismatches.head(10)) print("\nAborting file save to protect data integrity.") sys.exit() # ========================================================= # 6. EXPORT FINALIZED SYNTHETIC DATASETS # ========================================================= print("\nExporting final combined files...") df_final_hhs.to_csv(final_hhs_path, index=False) df_final_persons.to_csv(final_persons_path, index=False) print("\n--- INTEGRITY CHECKS ---") print(f"Combined Households Row Count: {len(df_final_hhs):,}") print(f"Combined Persons Row Count: {len(df_final_persons):,}") print( f"Households ID Range: {df_final_hhs['hh_id'].min()} to {df_final_hhs['hh_id'].max()}" ) print(f"Persons unique household keys: {df_final_persons['hh_id'].nunique():,}") unmatched_persons = ~df_final_persons["hh_id"].isin(df_final_hhs["hh_id"]) print(f"Unmatched Person Records: {unmatched_persons.sum()}") print("\nSuccess! Combined files exported cleanly.")

docs.title: Introduction¶
docs.text: This notebook converts PopulationSim outputs into ABM-ready household and person tables. It renames fields, creates continuous household and person identifiers, and combines non-GQ and dorm-student populations into one final synthetic population.

docs.title: Contents¶
docs.text:
• Configuration and output-path setup
  • Dorm-student and non-GQ output standardization
  • Continuous identifier creation
  • Final household/person concatenation and export

docs.title: Workflow¶
docs.text:
1. Load the configured PopulationSim output folders for non-GQ and dorm-student runs.
  2. Rename fields and prepare separate ABM-ready household and person outputs.
  3. Offset identifiers where needed so combined records remain unique.
  4. Concatenate the two populations and write final CSV files.

docs.title: Public Use Notes¶
docs.text:
• Run this notebook after both PopulationSim scenarios have completed successfully.
  • Confirm configured output folders match the model run date before exporting final ABM files.

docs.title: Stage ABM-ready PopulationSim outputs¶
docs.text: Loads the configured PopulationSim outputs, renames fields to the ABM schema, stages separate non-GQ and dorm-student household/person files, and preserves the source scenario distinction for final combination.

docs.title: Combine staged household and person outputs¶
docs.text: Reads the staged non-GQ and dorm-student records, offsets identifiers to keep them unique, concatenates both populations, and writes the final household and person files for ABM use.
